## Worlds/Era iPhone/Scrolling

The class '''gui_scroll''' lets you create a [[Creation/Dev/Script/Client/GuiScrollCtrl|GuiScrollCtrl]] with iPhone-like scrolling. For PC users, it displays a scroll bar, but for iPhone users, they can manipulate it just like a native control.

### Receiving Mouse Events
Specify a "clickEvent" variable, with a value such as "onMyScrollClicked", and it will be called when the user clicks, with the parameters:
 keymod, mx, my, clicks, mouseNumber

The event is called on the object specified in the 'scroll.callObject' variable.

### Optimization for Lists
For simplicity, it's easy to create lists without coding your own row detection for clicks. Set 'scroll.list' to the [[Creation/Dev/Script/Client/GuiScrollCtrl|GuiTextListCtrl]] object you create, and it will automagically function. See the example below.

### Example
 //#CLIENTSIDE
 function onCreated() {
   new GuiWindowCtrl("iPhoneTest_Window") {
     profile = iPhoneWindowProfile;
     
     width = 300;
     height = 300;
     
     clientRelative = visible = true;
     canMinimize = canClose = canMaximize = canResize = false;
     
     text = "iPhone Window";
     
     new GuiScrollCtrl("iPhoneTest_Scroll") {
       profile = iPhoneScrollProfile;
       
       x = 0;
       y = 0;
       
       width = iPhoneTest_Window.width - 30;
       height = iPhoneTest_Window.height - 32;
       
       this.join("gui_scroll");
       
       temp.scroll = this;
       
       new GuiTextListCtrl("iPhoneTest_List") {
         profile = iPhoneTextListProfile;
         
         x = 0;
         y = 0;
         
         this.clearRows();
         
         // fill it with crap
         for (temp.i = 0; i < 100; i ++) {
           this.addRow(0, "Item " @ (i + 1));
           
           c ++;
         }
         
         scroll.list = this;
       }
     }
   }
 }

### '''Esteria'''

[[Image:Login_server_esteria.png|right]]

#### '''About Esteria'''

Esteria is a server that was first created by [[User:NicoX|Nico]]. He brought together a group of developers to help with the project. Some of them include [[User:Crow|Crow]] and [[User:Shakram|Angelu]]. The project was first known as "Eden", though the name was changed later.

[[User:NicoX|Nico]] went away for some time, and [[User:Crow|Crow]] and [[User:Shakram|Angelu]] kept up the server with their graphics, scripts and levels.

Eventually, the server got shut down; [[User:NicoX|Nico]] couldn't keep it up.

Later, [[User:NicoX|Nico]] was on his friend's account, looking for a server that would need a scripter. That's when he came on Graalopolis. It was going far downhill than what the owner, [[User:Switch|Switch]], expected. [[User:NicoX|Nico]] asked to be a scripter there, and [[User:Switch|Switch]] accepted.

Then, because the server wasn't what [[User:Switch|Switch]] wanted, [[User:NicoX|Nico]] asked if he could implant his old server into this downhill one. And, yet again, [[User:Switch|Switch]] agreed. They had to wait a long time before they got the few things that was left of the old server. Infact, they were very lucky, meeting up with [[User:Shakram|Angelu]] again, for he had most of it... atleast... we think. Otherwise we don't know where it came from!

So, the server was rebuilt, with the tileset they had, and the scripters Stan, [[User:Chompy|Chompy]], and, of course, [[User:Crow|Crow]], who stuck with Esteria the whole way.

Just a few days later, [[User:Shakram|Angelu]] decided to help working on the project again. Though that didn't last too long. He left because someone pretended that his work was stolen, and [[User:Shakram|Angelu]] got pissed of it and quit, because he already heard that alot of times before.

### Server Information
EUROPA IS AN ABANDONED SERVER DUE TO THE ABSENCE OF THE OWNER

Europa is an upcoming Graal server led by Vinka.  He has worked extremely hard to finally present this preview of his server.

Europa will be a server with graphics similar to servers such as Graal Kingdoms, including a painted tileset that Vinka has created.  On the other hand, however, the gameplay will be similar to servers such as Graal Classic.  If you are interested in viewing more information written by Vinka himself, you can scroll down to the bottom of this page and view an interview that was conducted with him.

### Staff Team and  Hirings

Europa is still looking for new members to its expanding staff team.  For more information, please view [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?t=134262509 Europa's Hiring Thread].  

Here is a list of current staff.  Please note that the staffing of Europa may seem different than that other servers in terms of administration; Vinka, Europa's Project Leader, encourages an environment where all of his staff work together at an equal level with an equal rank.  Each staff has equal rights to other staff in terms of management, and should govern themselves and seek help from Vinka or other members of their team when they have questions or need help.  Also those who help the server from time to time, but aren't necessarily a full time staff have been organized under the "Contributors" category.

### A Moment With Vinka

'''Vinka, the owner and manager of Europa, has graciously agreed to take part in an interview about his server.  Here it is!'''


'''Global News Team:''' I've heard a lot of interesting things about Europa and I've decided that I it would be great if I interviewed you to accompany your new hiring thread!  Could you summarize in a few sentences what your server, Europa, is all about? 

'''Vinka:''' Europa is basically my own vision of what Graal needs in a server.  Simplicity, user friendliness, engaging events, and distinct graphics; Europa utilizes a gameplay much like Classic, but with more of a visual inspiration from Graal Kingdoms.

'''GNT:''' Okay.  I think readers are interested in even more in-depth questions, so I will be asking you some others.  Next up... I know that Europa has not only an interesting storyline, but one that operates in a way that Graal has not yet seen.  Can you give some insight about this?

'''Vinka:''' I liked the idea of having the storyline unfold and build as you go, as if you were the co-author, instead of viewing the storyline on a set track.  Lots of focus on player and non-player interaction.  We're using the story to help you decide which side you"ll take.  You were once the king over the lands of Europa, until your death two centuries prior. Since then utter chaos has emerged and you have been resurrected to rebuild and save Europa.

'''GNT:''' That does sound interesting.  I will most definitely be playing Europa when the server hits its final release!  Another thing to catch my eye on Europa was the amazing graphical style.  There seems to be a mixture of a "artsy" theme and a "cartoony" theme.  How do you plan for this theme to continue to develop?  Is there any advice you would like to give to people who are reading this that wish to be graphic artists for your server?

'''Vinka:''' We're still pretty much in the experimentation phase. I am looking for a working combination of our own artsy/painted graphics and pixel art. The style is slowly finding its solid foundation. If I were to give any advice for any graphic artists willing to apply is to be flexible and dare to step out of your comfort zone.  The style won't be too sctrict and I'd really love other people's stylistic ideas and suggestions.

'''GNT:''' Sounds cool.  From my understanding, Europa will have a kingdoms system that is similar to Maloria.  How will your server's gameplay vary from Maloria's?  What unique things will Europa have to offer?

'''Vinka:''' What is a 'Maloria'?  Next question.

'''GNT:''' Interesting... Well, thanks for taking the time to answer the previous questions I've asked; however, to close this interview, I have one more thing to ask: What do you plan to develop on Europa that will be most exciting for you?  What part of Europa will send a surge of excitement throughout the Graalian world?

'''Vinka:''' One of the greater things we have planned is the Kingdoms System. There will be frequent hosted Nation Wars, in which you can gain "Honor Points," the currency of Europa. This introduces diverse aesthetic items for your avatar, kingdom ranks, houses, and many more planned rewards.

'''GNT:''' Intersting...  Well, again, I appreciate your time today and look forward to covering any future news about Europa.  Best of luck to you and your server!

## Worlds/Europa/News

[[Category:Europa]][[Category:News]]
{{Template:News}}

=News=
To read the official [[Worlds/Europa|Europa]] news articles click on the links below:
* [[News/2011/June|Europa News 10 June 2011]] 

### 10 June 2011

[[User:BigBear3|Pat]], of the [[Global News Team]], sat down for an interview with [[User:Vinka|Vinka]], the owner of [[Worlds/Europa|Europa]]

'''Pat''': Okay, let's start with the basics. What type of server is this going to be?
	
'''Vinka''': The main concept is that you're a reborn king, resurrected by the goddess of Europa, Epa, and you should find your way back in one of the kingdoms (Western / Westonia, or Eastern / Erran). [You will] fight for your kingdom.  We will introduce a leveling system and a self creating storyline... more [info] on this later. 
	
'''Pat''': So there are two kingdoms. I am assuming that they are rival nations and [that] there will be PVP.  What kind of PVP combat will Europa feature, if any? 
	
'''Vinka''': PVP will be one of our greatest focuses on Europa; although it's not fully planned in detail yet, my current vision on it is to have both challenging world PVP (raiding on the opposing kingdom's city, or sneaking into it as an Assassin - Did I mention the three classes?  [They are] Soldier, Assassin, and Sorcerer) and...Battlefield Battles.  [In Battlefield Battles], once [every] three days, this big war event will be held between the two kingdoms.  The winning kingdom receives Nation Points.  (These will be one of the main currencies on Europa [used] to gain equipment and rare items.) 
	
'''Pat''': Wow, I am excited to see this in action!  It all sounds like a good time. 
	
Could you tell me more about the classes?
	
'''Vinka''': Sure.  These too are still not fully planned, but I'll try to give a brief explanation of my current idea.
	
Like I said there will be three classes: the Soldier, the Assassin and the Sorcerer.  I like to prevent things from being too complex and scattered, so I just stuck to three, keeping things cohesive.
	
..There will be multiple branches within these classes to offer players to customize their playstyle.  For example, sorcerers could choose to become a pure magic attacker who, an arcane conjurer, uses warps to offer a very tactical approach to PVP and PVE, or a Muse, who boosts their alies in stats and heal s themselves or others. 
	
'''Pat''': This all sounds really inventive and unique.  I personally like to play the healer myself.
	
What kind of items and / or equipment will Europa feature?
	
'''Vinka''': Ah yes, weapons.  We obviously won't have basic classic swords. We're gonna a wide range of equipable weapons (much like the kind you see on Zodiac and Graal Kingdoms), armors and spells. 
	
[Whether or not] we're going to make the equipped armor visual is not clear yet, [because] I'm not sure whether I'm going to stick with classic bodies or not.
	
'''Pat''': Well judging by what graphics I've seen so far, the weapons will be something to look at.  Well, that's all of my time for now. 
	
Is there anywhere we can look for future updates?
	
'''Vinka''': Yes, right here.  Here they can [view updates]:
http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?t=134263422

## Worlds/Fusion

[[Category:Worlds]][[Category:Fusion]]

Fusion is a modern styled server with a good tileset, itemsystem, banks, trains and cars and it will have customized player outfits system, unique weapons, factories and much more in near future!

Please don't expect to much at the moment because Fusion is currently under development but it is progressed more like many other development servers. At the moment, you are able to drive cars, go by train, use ATM's and the inventory (also you can drop items and change the order of items in the inventory) and use some provisory weapons.

You can't really compare Fusion with other modern servers because it has its own style (e.g. tileset patched-up out of free GFX) and concepts of handling different things like items (you can drop items and will stay as owner of the item until you double click it), cars etc.

## Worlds/GraalRealms

[[Category:Worlds]][[Category:GraalRealms]]
### History of GR

Graal Realms was created by Ryan (SSJRyan) and Brad (Yendi) on December 30th, 2002.

Graal Realms was one of the first 'socialization' servers ever created on graal.
It was a very different server compared to many servers of the kind out then, only because it was a server that did not discriminate on who they hired, as long as GR figured they were making a difference to that staff members development abilities.

Graal Realms was the first home to many staff members including, but certainly not limited to:

Nate (Bioboi)

JerZ (?)

Zer0 (stoopidman13)

Brad (Yendi)

Fulcaire (Gotenks250)

Dasher (DemonicDemon)

And many, many other staff members that made GR their home for a full year.

Graal Realms was a bit hit onto the graal field, hosting only 20 levels, 20 staff members, and occasionally up to 15 players, once giving GR a playercount that exceeded Unholy Nations playercount (79:72)

Graal Realms levels were miniscule, and horribly made. It was just the help of a small group of newbie developers that created a fair events house, and created a working form of paintball (the second server in graal history that had it!)

Graal Realms lived until summer of '03. During this time Ryan had Real-Life issues to deal with, Brad left for newly developing Atrius, Zer0 stuck around, along with Nate, Fulcaire, and a few other loyal GRealmians for the last few months.

In November of 2003, Graal Realms became a deserted wasteland, and all the staff finally left.

Although Graal Realms was an amazing playercount server, and a great place for new developers to have started in, it was a gigantic failure, even going as far as to be bashed by Brad '''AND''' Ryan to how horrible it really was.

Great times, strange server, and a bunch of hope until the end.

That was the Graal Realms legacy.

## Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands

[[Category:Worlds]][[Category:Bomy Island]]
{{playerworld}}

=History=
Previously known as '''Graal 2001''', [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands|Graal Bomy Lands]] is considered a big change in the history of [[Graal]]; it was one of the first worlds to introduce ghost mode, and pioneered many other changes. Serverside scripting and many other functions were first tested here. The server was the second official project (after [[Worlds/Classic|Classic]]) to come to [[Graal]]. The methods of designing levels and making scripts have changed a lot since this world's original creation. Due to the fact that Graal Bomy Lands only allowed [[Pay to Play]] accounts to play on the server, it brought in money to Graal, which made it possible to create better Graal software. A lot of the scripting we are now able to use is only possible due to the Graal-wide introduction of the [[NPC Server]], originally designed for Graal Bomy Lands.

The success of [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands|Graal Bomy Lands]] led to another Gold server: [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]]. The classic [[Graal]] look changed, and features such as psuedo-3D mapping and semi-realistic characters were added.

[[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands|Graal Bomy Lands]] became a classic server awhile after [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] came out, and [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands|Graal Bomy Lands]] was left with an extremely small amount of players. [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands|Graal Bomy Lands]] was popular for a short time; however, it was later removed from the Classic list, and left in the dark abyss of the [[Private Server]] list.

Many [[Graalian]]s are attempting to revive this tossed-aside server, and even a '''Graal2001 Supporter''' guild was created to help support it.

On February 20th, 2006 the server was reopened to the public and resided under the classic playerworlds list.

Shortly after, the server reopening failed and a new team began working on another revision of the server. The new revision has been renamed "[[Worlds/Bomy Island|Bomy Island]]" and has been in development for roughly one year.

=Guides=
* [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands/Bread Making|Bread Making]] (for Humans)
* [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands/Apple Pie Making|Apple Pie Making]] (for Humans)
* [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands/Fishing|Fishing]] (for Humans)
* [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands/Pearl Diving|Pearl Diving]] (for Bomies)

## Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands/Apple Pie Making

[[Category:Bomy Island]]
{{spoiler}}

''This page is essentially a duplicate of the [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands/Bread Making|Bread Making guide]], as the job is nearly identical.''

[[Image:Apple_pie_bakery.png|frame|left|Apple Pie Bakery]]

Baking apple pies can be a well paying job if you can find the time to farm the many apples necessary. You can sell apple pies for 6g each, and buy apple pies for 4g each from '''Elppa'''.

You can find the '''Apple Pie Bakery''' in '''Harmonia'''.

<br style="clear:both;">

=Obtaining Wheat=
[[Image:Obtaining_wheat.png|frame|left|Obtaining wheat]]
[[Image:Wheat_basket.png|frame|right|Wheat basket]]

Nearby, you can obtain wheat from a pile of wheat baskets next to '''Bako'''. Simply touch the pile of wheat baskets to obtain a basket.

After obtaining a wheat basket, be careful not to do anything other than walk, this will likely result in breaking your wheat basket. On your way to the '''Apple Pie Bakery''' you will either have to traverse the maze path through the bushes or hope someone has been kind enough to cut down bushes for you.

<br style="clear:both;">

=Rolling Dough=
[[Image:Rolling_apple_pie_dough.png|frame|left|Rolling apple pie dough]]
[[Image:Rolled_apple_pie_dough.png|frame|right|Rolled apple pie dough]]

When you get inside of the bakery you will want to find an open table and place down your wheat, to do this simply touch the top of the table, you will also need to have four [[Image:Appleicon.png|Apple]] '''Apples''' in your [[Image:Foodicon.png|Food Basket]] '''Food Basket''' in order to do this. After the wheat has been placed, grab a [[Image:Doughrollericon.png|Roller]] '''Roller''' from nearby, and then roll your dough into an unbaked apple pie by pressing '''D''' rapidly. ''Be careful not to let your dough sit without being rolled as it may become unowned and other players will then be able to take it.''

After your dough reaches 100% it will turn into an unbaked apple pie, you should then grab a [[Image:Bredstackicon.png|Bread Stack]] '''Bread Stack''' from nearby, and pick up the unbaked apple pie by pressing '''D'''.

<br style="clear:both;">

=Baking Apple Pies=
[[Image:Baking_apple_pie.png|frame|left|Baking apple pie]]
[[Image:Baked_apple_pie.png|frame|right|Baked apple pie]]

Carrying your unbaked apple pie, bring it to one of the ovens and place it down on an empty slot by pressing '''D''', then wait patiently while your apple pie cooks.

When the apple pie turns brown, it has finished cooking. Quickly grab the apple pie again by pressing '''D''' with the breadstack under the apple pie. Then bring the apple pie to '''Elppa''' to sell it for 4g.

<br style="clear:both;">

[[Image:Burned_apple_pie.png|frame|left|Burnt apple pie]] If you fail to take your baked apple pie in time, it will end up burning, turning into a waste of time, dough, and apples.

<br style="clear:both;">

You can find the '''Bread Bakery''' in '''Harmonia'''.

## Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands/Fishing

[[Category:Bomy Island]]
{{spoiler}}

=Fishing Rod=
[[Image:Harmonia fishing shop.png|frame|left|Harmonia fishing shop]] The [[Image:Fishingrodicon.png|Fishing Rod]] '''Fishing Rod''', if you have bait, will allow you to cast your line into water and pull it in -- hopefully with a fish on the line. Press '''D''' to cast, then press '''A''' to reel the line in.

You can purchase the [[Image:Fishingrodicon.png|Fishing Rod]] '''Fishing Rod''' from the Harmonia fishing shop for 20g.

You can find out how many pounds of fish you currently have by saying '''show fishes'''.
<br style="clear:both;">

=Baits=
Baits allow you to catch fish, the better your bait, the heavier the fish you can catch. A bait will never run out from use.

You can purchase baits from the Harmonia fishing shop for various prices.

[[Image:Hook_1.png|Bait 1]] Bait 1 (10g)

Can catch fish up to 3 pounds.

[[Image:Hook_2.png|Bait 2]] Bait 2 (30g)

Can catch fish up to 8 pounds.

[[Image:Hook_3.png|Bait 3]] Bait 3 (100g)

Can catch fish up to 12 pounds.

=Locations=
You can fish anywhere there are fish, although many fishermen prefer to fish in spots where many fish are present and tend to not move that much.

### Underground Lake
[[Image:Underground_Lake_fish_pond.png|frame|left|Underground Lake fish pond]] The Underground Lake fish pond can be found close to the Underground Lake train station. There is also a fishing shop nearby where you can sell your fish. This fish pond is a popular spot for fishing.

The fish in this pond weigh up to 3 pounds each.

<br style="clear:both;">

### Silverstun Pier
[[Image:Silverstun_pier.png|frame|right|Silverstun Pier]]
Silverstun's Sea can be found in the north-east region of [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands|Graal Bomy Lands]]. You can rent a boat here to help you get to more fish  ('''Not functional right now!!''').

The fish in Silverstun's Sea weigh up to 12 pounds each.

<br style="clear:both;">

=Selling your catch=
You may sell your fish at the Harmonia fishing shop or the Underground Lake fishing shop, which both buy 15 pounds of fish for 1g.

## Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands/Pearl Diving

[[Category:Bomy Island]]
{{spoiler}}

[[Image:Diving_area.png|frame|left|Diving area]]
[[Image:Diving_underwater.png|frame|right|Diving underwater]]

Diving for pearls is a lucrative job for new bomy players to [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands|Graal Bomy Lands]] as it costs nothing to do. Although it costs nothing, it is very tedious and time demanding.

In order to dive, you will need the [[Image:Diveicon.png|Diving NPC]] '''Diving''' NPC. You can get the NPC from the diving area next to old '''Zormite Island''', which is found near '''Mt. Antora'''.

There are many diving areas that exist on [[Worlds/Graal Bomy Lands|Graal Bomy Lands]].

In order to dive, press '''S''' while standing over a diving area. After diving you will usually find yourself in a dark underwater cave. If you wish to return to the surface, look for a square shape and press '''S''' while over it.

<br style="clear:both;">

=Obtaining Pearls=
[[Image:Seashell_underwater.png|frame|left|Seashell]]
[[Image:Open_seashell_underwater.png|frame|right|Open seashell]]

If you are in a pearl diving spot, you will notice several seashells in the underwater cave. These seashells will open randomly, hopefully with a pearl. By kicking a seashell (by pressing '''A''' while facing and against a seashell) you will improve the chance that a seashell opens randomly.

If a seashell is open and has a pearl, you may take the pearl by simply touching it.

<br style="clear:both;">

=Pearls=
There are three kinds of pearls, white, black, and pink. White being the least valuable, and pink being the most valuable.

[[Image:Pearl1.gif|White Pearl]] '''White Pearl'''

Sells for 1g for every 7 white pearls.

[[Image:Pearl2.gif|Black Pearl]] '''Black Pearl'''

Sells for 1g for every 4 black pearls.

[[Image:Pearl3.gif|Pink Pearl]] '''Pink Pearl'''

Sells for 1g for every 2 pink pearls.

<br style="clear:both;">

=Selling your pearls=
[[Image:Selling_pearls.png|frame|left|Podaka]] You may sell your pearls to '''Podaka''', who is nearby, to the northeast of the old '''Zormite Island'''.

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms

[[Category:Worlds]][[Category:Graal Kingdoms]][[Category:Roleplaying]]
[[Image:Login_server_kingdoms.png|left]][[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] is an adventurous massively multi [[player]] online [[roleplaying]] experience. Explore 3-D terrain in a 2-D environment, while battling monsters, forging friendships, and collecting treasures.

Interact with in-game characters and creatures, role play and chat with other players from around the world. [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] allows players to become a part of the story. Players can build houses, protect kingdoms, battle in tournaments, compete in events, and much more!

[[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] goes beyond the norm, with a growing community and new and exciting features being added all the time. Players can do odd jobs, tame and own pets, battle monsters, form groups with other players, and make their own items and weapons. An important part of [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]], is the great amount of communication that is possible in the game. Through live chatting onscreen, to sending private messages, and even mailing other players letters to their online homes! Battling is action-packed, with a wide variety of weapons and an even wider variety of magic spells. The large assortment of items can be organized from the easy to use drag and drop inventory system. Players can choose from a selection of classes such as Warrior, Sorcerer, Thieves, Barbarians, and even Priests!

[[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] is a graal [[Gold server]] that requires a [[Gold Account]] to play.

More information about Graal Kingdoms:
* [[Worlds/Graal_Kingdoms/New_Player_Guide|Guide for new players]]
* [[Worlds/Graal_Kingdoms/Spells_Guide|Spells Guide]]

=Technology=
The graphics in [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] are a fine blend of 2-D artwork and 3-D artwork, meshed together to form a unique experience unlike any other. Graphics are highly detailed, colourful, and creative. From boats and houses, to trees and monsters, [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] provides a visual treat for the player.

[[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] is one of the most advanced [[Graal]] servers online, and differs from other servers in many ways, primarily in its integration with the [[mudlib]] from the [http://crossfire.real-time.com/ Crossfire] game.

=Features=
### Jobs
[[Image:GraakKingdoms_jobs_mining.jpg|thumb|left]] [[Image:GraakKingdoms_jobs_baking.jpg|thumb|right]] Players can work many different jobs in order to advance further into the game. Mining for gems and other supplies to craft into your own goods. Become a farmer and farm crops to bake into culinary delights. You can even become a lumberjack and plant trees to chop down and turn into wood that can be crafted into many useable items. Craft a fishing rod and build a ship to become a fisherman. You can also try your luck as tradesman. Travel around the world to collect and buy items from all islands to sell or trade them away to people from other islands. Whatever you want to become, you have the possibilities to realize it!

### Houses and Fortifications
[[Image:GraakKingdoms_housebuilding.jpg|thumb|left]][[Image:GraalKingdoms_houseshop.jpg|thumb|right]]If you plan on settling down, why not build yourself a home? Mine stones and build walls, chop trees to get wood for the roof, until your new house is complete! Then once your home is built, gather up some furniture and decorate your indoor area in any way you'd like. Your house can even include a mailbox, in which you can receive letters and even items from players! You can also open your own shop to sell goods you produced to earn some money. Or just make some big party together with your friends. To keep out all unwanted visitors, you can construct fortification pillars around your land. But be careful, as pillars can be destroyed! Create your own garden around your house where you will be able to plant flowers, trees and other nice things to give everything a nice look.

#### Construction
 
'''You will need the following materials to construct your house:'''

 * 1 House flag
 * 5 Logs
 * 90 Stone
 * 150 Boards 
 * 300 Nails

Here is the order in which you will place each item on your house:

1 House Flag -> 5 Logs -> 90 Stones -> 1 Board and 2 Nails (This last step repeats until all 300 Nails and 150 Boards are exhausted.)

### Role Player System
[[Image:GraakKingdoms_event_worker.jpg|thumb|left]][[Image:GraalKingdoms_clothsshop.jpg|thumb|right]][[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] has a massive role playing engine to allow an exciting experiences. Hundreds of items, loads of weapons, and a large array of magical spells and prayers allow for an unique role playing environment. Different items allow for different statistical effects to your base stats, enabling every player to strengthen their character with bigger and better items and weapons. A large assortment of items can be mixed together to create other items by using alchemy. Pick clothes from a big assortment or submit your ones to customize your outfit. Take part in role playing events and have lots of fun. Join one of five Kingdoms and undergo a great role playing experience in a nation together with friends. Making for fun experimentation and surprising results!

### Interaction between Players
[[Image:GraakKingdoms_zorbiburst.jpg|thumb|left]][[Image:GraakKingdoms_event_snowball.jpg|thumb|right]]Players can interact with each other in many ways. Through weekly tournaments and events like shipwars, mazes, role playing events, trivia events, quiz events and much more. Even in mini-games, such as kart racing, zorbi burst, metris, ice hockey and soccer players can interact with each other. Also every kingdom organises partys and big events which are used to give special kingdomitems to the winner. Players can group with others to form parties in order to take on large quests or battle monsters in dungeons, mazes and haunted houses. Screenshots submission and news announce winners of events and competitions so every [[player]] can have a chance to be recognized.

### Dungeons and Monster fighting
Players can travel through dark and eerie dungeons that have many twists, turns, and dead ends. Monsters of all shapes and sizes lurk through the corridors awaiting any challenger that crosses their path. By defeating monsters, players gain fighting experience which is used to gain levels to grow stronger. Battling monsters also allows for players to earn treasure from their victories. Monsters have different patterns of attack and come in many shapes and sizes, so beware!

### Animals and Pets
[[Image:GraalKingdoms_pets.jpg|thumb|left]]There is a variety of animals that roam the lands in [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]]. Some of these animals can be fed and tamed to follow you and much more. If you have a horse, you can feed it and ride it for faster travel over the land. You can even add armor to your horse to protect it during battles. Pets can also help to lighten the load by carrying some of your heavy goods.

[[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Songs|Flute songs]] can be used to control pets on [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]].

### Ships
[[Image:GraakKingdoms_ships.jpg|thumb|right]]Dream of travelling the seas? In [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]], it's possible! With enough effort and wood, you can build a grand ship and sail around the world! Gather a crew together and explore the vast sea, or search for passing ships to destroy with your cannons! Ships can be damaged to the point of sinking, but they can also be repaired. You'll need to find a good crew to take on the rough waters!

### Interface
[[Image:GraalKingdoms_interface.jpg|thumb|left]]Players can buy, sell, trade, and equip their items and weapons with the help of an easy to use inventory system. The inventory features drag and drop capabilities that allow the player to drop items on the ground or into bags or other containers they are carrying. The inventory displays currently worn items such as armour, rings, and amulets, cloaks, along with the character's stats and items. It also gives informations about your characters stats, experience and resistance.

### Kingdoms
[[Image:Login_server_kingdoms2.png|thumb|right]]
Players can choose to join one of five Kingdoms. Each Kingdom is unique with it's own island, background information, and design. Players can take part in Kingdom events, wars, tournaments, and much more. Every Kingdom has a style of it's own, which allows the [[player]] to choose what style best suits them. Players can take on the role of a Kingdom member and even climb the ranks for a high position in the Kingdom. Become a defender for your Kingdom and wage war with other Kingdoms for honour and glory!

There are five different kingdoms on [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]].


#### [[Dustari]]
[[Image:Kicon_dustari.png|left]]Dustari is a imperialistic monarchy based off of medieval times. The current King is [[User:Todd45|Todd45]].

#### [[Crescent Pirates]]
[[Image:Kicon_pirates.png|left]]Crescent Pirates is a kingdom containing a large navy, but a rather small land army. The current Governor is [[User:FBI|FBI]].

#### [[Forest]]
[[Image:Kicon_forest.png|left]]Forest is a nature-based kingdom.  Its houses are formed out of trees. Forest was disbanded as a kingdom.

#### [[Samurai|Samurai]]
[[Image:Kicon_samurai.png|left]]Samurai is a kingdom based on feudal Japan and it's traditions.  It's houses have distinctive paper walls and pagoda roofs. The current Emperor is [[User:NicoX|Nico]].

#### [[Zormite|Zormite]]
[[Image:Kicon_zormite.png|left]]Zormite is a kingdom that was recently taken over by drows but has recently be restored to proper leadership. The current Emperor is [[User:NOOB|NOOB]].

=Storyline=
#### Peaceful Life
Life in the [[Graalian]] world was peaceful. People built towns, and mined the land of its riches. Farmers planted happily, making sure to water their plants for the upcoming Sylvester.

Merchants sold goods in the streets, as men on horseback patrolled the area for thieves. The people enjoyed the warmth of the day, as the Bomy Moons approached. The world seemed to be in perfect balance.

#### Preparing for Danger
The world was unprepared for what was about to happen. Sightings of a large meteor were taking place all over the land. Scholars revealed that it wasn't a meteor, but a moon. For many years, the Suns of the Bomy planet had passed near the land. Sometimes, the Suns would pass right over one another. Causing a Sylvester, that heated the [[Graalian]] world with bright red intensity.

However, something had went wrong. The Bomy Moon became disaligned from the planet, and was hurdling towards the peaceful world of Graal.

All the [[Graalians]] could do was prepare for the worst. The Moon crashed heavily into the sea, causing massive tidal waves to wash over the land. It appeared that the damage had been done... but it was just beginning...

#### Worldly Changes
The impact of the Moon caused devastating underground destruction. Underwater volcanoes became active from the intense earthquake, causing islands to emerge from the sea. Lava became hard as stone quickly after being engulfed in water. Clouds of ash arose from the water and into the sky.

The tidal waves began to subside, and the half-submerged Moon could be seen in the middle of the land.

#### Unwelcome Visitors
Approaching the Moon, [[Graalians]] witnessed what appeared to be movement on it's surface.

Bomies began to emerge from the craters. When the alien bomies looked around the land, they became enraged. They discovered that their own Bomy race, were being treated like [[Graalian]] pets. This caused anger in the alien bomies, and they immediately began to attack the [[Graalians]]. The people fought valiantly to save their home. After a long battle, it appeared that the alien bomies had been defeated.

#### Turn for the Worst
Knowing that they were outnumbered and beaten, the alien bomies enslaved the minds of the small creatures and plants on the land. Seemingly harmless plants and animals began attacking the [[Graalians]]. The people had no choice but to retreat. There was little hope left for them, as they quickly fled the island on ships from every shore. They left, knowing that they would return later, to retaliate this assualt. They sailed for what seemed like forever, until they finally found land...

#### Final Hope
Five islands were discovered by the [[Graalian]] people as they approached the shores. The people decided to rebuild their lives on these new islands. They built towns and ports, houses and shops. Soon, they had decided to reclaim the land they had lost. Kingdoms were formed on each island, in an effort to prepare for the approaching battle. These Kingdoms became known as Dustari, Forest, Pirate, Samurai, and Zormite. Each kingdom built armies and castles in preparation for war. It appeared that hope was once again restored in the people of the new lands...

#### Destiny Awaits
Time is running out... The alien bomies are also building up their civilization. The crashing of the moon has awakened evil deep within the world. It won't be long before the evil spreads to take your land for its own. You must help reclaim the island that was once called home.

### Bigworm

The Bigworm is a fearsome creature that can only be found in brutal tire maps. It burrows underground and uses stealth to strike unsuspecting foes, however, with a keen eye you can spot the worms path underground and predict the worms position to pre-empt its attacks. The worm also has a nasty surprise for those who are lucky enough to slay the beast. Upon death the worm spawns snakes and little worms in a last ditch attempt to slay the person that killed it.

In the past worms never used to have an image and didn't show burrows underground, this evidently meant they were completely invisible until they attacked their foes. This brought up an ingenious solution, by using the detect monster spell the worms position underground could be located and thus could be attacked before they had a chance to strike. Even though you can see the burrows the detect monster tactic can still be useful today to pinpoint the worms location.

[[Image:G2k2bigworm.png]]

=Lords=
Lords are monsters that,through some unknown method, have become many times larger and stronger than their normal counterparts. Many theories have been created to try to explain this phenomena, ranging from Demonic influence, to simple overeating. To this day however, the real cause remains unknown. 

All Lords are massive in size, and can be heard off in the distance, giving those who stand no chance a possibility of escape. They are extremely strong, and should be considered a threat by even medium strength warriors. All Lords have the ability to summon lesser minions, and to set traps, though they only seem to make use of this ability indoors.

The Battle Mushroom Lord, as the name suggests, is a Battle Mushroom that has grown to immense size. It is colored an odd black and gray instead of the normal bright colors of the Battle Mushroom, and hops along, leaving large indents in the ground.

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Bel'la Olplyn

[[Category:Bel'la Olplyn]]
{{stub}}
Bel'la Olplyn is a kingdom on [[Graal Kingdoms]] that was founded by removing the [[Zormite]] kingdom.  The kingdom with the second most if not the most history of all the kingdoms on Graal.

### The Big Scam and the Founding of Bel'la Olplyn

While still second-in-command of [[Zormite]], Etien scammed several items including Phoenix items from Jalexia, a member of [[Crescent Pirates]] by telling her that he was only borrowing the items.  This scam is considered by many to be the largest scam in the history of Graal Kingdoms in terms of item value.

In response to this Crescent Pirates declared war on Zormite.  However, this turned out to be a farce when instead of pursuing any real justice they simply accepted a Zormite Shield from Etien and "executed" him.  Etien and Kefkin, who was leader of Zormite at the time, then created Bel'la Olplyn and tried to use it as an excuse that they had been sufficiently punished for the scam even though Etien still had the scammed items.

Spiker/Marvel Seltin, while he was still a member of Bel'la Olplyn, confirmed that the founding of the kingdom was an attempt to cover-up the scam when he said, "Etien and Graynt (Kefkin) are trying to start over, just with perfect items, they have spoke with me straight from the telephone."

When translated the Drow phrase "Bel'la Olplyn" literally means "To Honor Thieves"

### The First Response

A few former members of the [[Graal2001]] Zormites banded together with [[Dustari]], [[Samurai]] and even Crescent Pirates in order to restore [[Zormite]].  Although no Bel'la Olplyn members showed up to defend the kingdom, except Etien who was chased into his house within minutes, the staff refused to restore the Zormite kingdom.

### Other Facts about Bel'la Olplyn

- Etien (who changed his name to Elghin) was screenshotted [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/attachment.php?attachmentid=33098 calling for terrorist attacks against the United States].

- There are known scammers, including Draven, Oasa and EndlessX in Bel'la Olplyn.  EndlessX has even scammed another Bel'la Olplyn member and was not punished.

- EndlessX was screenshotted [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/attachment.php?attachmentid=33764 denouncing the concept of RP] even though he is a member of a kingdom (Bel'la Olplyn).

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Bel'la Olplyn/Destruction Force

[[Category:Bel'la Olplyn]]
Taken from the [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?t=61572 founding thread].

Today Bjorn told me that he has effectively given up on the removal of Bel'la Olplyn and is now talking about some form of naming system that would restore Zormite but maintain Kefkin as leader.  Refusal to restore Zormite with Kefkin as leader now even though it would be easy to do so, however, suggests that this is simply another stalling tactic that will give us exactly what all the other stalling tactics the staff have used on the subject of Bel'la Olplyn - nothing.

For that reason, I'm launching the Bel'la Olplyn Destruction Force (BDOF), with the following goals.

1. The restoration of Zormite.

2. The removal and blacklisting of all scammers (including Etien) from the kingdom until they return the items they scammed to their rightful owners or, if the owner is no longer playing, to the staff.

The BDOF has no leadership, no tags and no applications.  Anybody who fights against Bel'la Olplyn in any way in order to achieve those two goals is a member.  The membership spans across all kingdoms and includes even members of Bel'la Olplyn itself.  If you see a member of Bel'la Olplyn on battle mode, kill them.  If you see a member of Bel'la Olplyn on another server, kill them.  Fight them IC and OOC.  Tell your friends about Bel'la Olplyn (http://h642101.serverkompetenz.net/Some_facts_about_Bel'la_Olplyn).  Tell your friends about the BDOF.  If you're a member of CP or Forest, tell your kingdom leader to declare war on Bel'la Olplyn, as Samurai and Dustari have done.  Zeppelin their castle.  Cannonball their boats.  Tell the staff to take expedient action on Bel'la Olplyn.  If you can think of a way to fight against Bel'la Olplyn, do it.  Just stay within the rules.

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Commands

[[Category:Graal Kingdoms Guides]][[Category:Graal Commands]]

### General Commands

'''/help''' - Lists help options.

'''/help commands''' - Lists common commands.

'''/help tables''' - Displays information about trading in the F2 window.

'''/swearfilter strict/on/off''' - Changes the level of chat restrictions heard by the player (swear filter is on by default).

### Game Commands

'''/addscore''' - Adds you to the 50 top players with the most exp list if you have enough exp, if you're inside the events score house the exp will be displayed on the 15 top skill boards.

'''/hiscore''' - displays the 50 top players with the most exp in the F2 window.

'''/disarm''' - Uses the disarm trap skill

'''/cast''' - Displays a list of all spells and prayers learned in the F2 window.

'''/cast <spellname>''' - Readies a spell or prayer to be casted.

'''/inventory''' - Shows all items in your inventory on the F2 window.

'''/useskill <skillname> ''' - Uses the skill stated in the command.

'''/title''' - Sets your title to be displayed on the /who list.

'''/resistances''' - Shows you current resistances in the F2 window.

'''/statistics''' - Displays your total exp, how much total exp you need for the next level, and the natural and real values of strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, power, and charm.

'''/mark <itemname>''' - Marks the item stated in the command.

'''/who''' - Displays all players online and whether they are in peaceful or battle mode. 

'''/skills''' - Displays a list of all skills and how much exp you have an how much exp to reach the next level.

'''/examine <itemname>'''- Displays information for the item stated in the command (same as right clicking on an item)

'''/drop <itemname>''' - Drops the item stated in the command.

'''/drop <itemname>, <itemname>''' - Same as /drop <itemname> but can be used to drop multiple items.

'''/recipes''' - Displays a list of all recipes learned in the F2 window.

'''/recipe <name>''' Displays the items needed for the recipe stated in the command.

'''/listen <volume>''' - Sets the volume level of messages. The higher the volume level is the more messages you'll get and the lower the level the less messages you get (/listen 0) being the fewest messages.

'''/search''' - Uses the find trap skill.

'''/dropall''' - Drops all items in your inventory.

### Party Commands

'''/party say''' - Sends a message to all party members.

'''/gsay''' - Same as /party say.

'''/party form <name>''' - Forms a new party.

'''/party join <name>''' - Joins an existing party.

'''/party kills''' - Displays all recent monsters killed by the party in the F2 window.

'''/party leave''' - Leaves the party

'''/party list''' - Displays a list of all parties in the F2 window.

'''/party passwd''' - Sets the password for the party.

'''/party who''' - Displays a list of all members for the party in the F2 window.

### House Commands

'''move house up/down/left/right''' - Moves playerhouses in the specified direction (Only works for those with the H right).

'''/lockdooropen''' - Turns a playerhouse into a shop.

'''/kick <account>''' - Kicks the specified account from the house.

### Pet Commands

'''name pet <petname>''' - Names the pet with the specified name.

### Kingdom Commands

'''/kingdoms tag''' - Sets your kingdom guild tag.

'''/ksay''' - Sends a message to all kingdom members online with your rank name, accountname then the message.

'''/kingdom leave''' - Leaves your current kingdom.

'''set tax <percent>''' - Sets the percentage of tax for market stands (Kingdom leaders only).

'''set rent <silvercoins>''' - Sets the rent rate for market stands Kingdom leaders only).

''':arrest <account> <time>''' - Adds the specified account to the kingdom pillory for the allotted time (Only works for those with the L right).

''':release''' - Releases the prisoner from the pillory (Only works for those with the L right).

''':show''' - Shows the account name of the prisoner in the pillory (Only works for those with the L right).

### Special Commands

'''/setcolor <colour>''' - Applies a glow to your character (you needed to finish the 2010 Halloween Quest or be a member of staff for this command to work).

### Staff Commands

''':room help''' - Lists commands and information about events (Events Masters only).

'''/ssay''' - Sends a message to all online staff members (staff only).

### Admin Commands

'''/dm boss''' - Allows admins to enter dungeon master mode.

'''/create <itemname>''' - Adds the item stated in the command to the admins inventory.

'''/add <itemname>''' - Same as /create.

'''/addexp <account> <amount>''' - adds the stated amount of exp to the accounts readied skill.

'''/setgod <account> <god>''' - Sets the stated god to the account.

'''/nowiz''' - Exits dungeon master mode.

'''/nodm''' - Same as /nowiz

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates

[[Category:Crescent Pirates]][[Category:Roleplaying]]
### General Facts
[[Image:G2k2maps pirates.png|thumb|left|Map of Crescent Isle]]
[[Image:Kicon pirates.png]][[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates|Crescent Pirates]] is one of the five kingdoms on Graal Kingdoms.
They, as the name suggest, have a pirate theme and their military is heavily leaning on their naval cunning.

### Documentation
* [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?t=76447 Joining Requirements]
* [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates/Article of Agreement|Article of Agreement]]
* [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?t=59557 The Pirate's Handbook]
* [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?p=1524745#post1524745 House Report]

### Pirate Development Projects
The pirate development team work on projects specific to the [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates|Crescent Pirates]] in an effort to improve the island, efficiency, and style of the kingdom. Official developers of the pirate development team have special access to [[Worlds/Kingdoms Debug|Kingdoms Debug]] to test and design new additions, however any player is welcome to submit new additions freely.

#### List of Current Development Projects
* [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?t=134260263 Pirate Developers Diary]
* [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?t=86275 Pirate Development Project]
* [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?t=134257607 Development Project]
* [http://forums.graalonline.com/forums/showthread.php?t=79428 New Pirate Items]

### History
The [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates|Crescent Pirates]], or Pirate Crew as it was called, was founded in Graal 2001 by [[User:Ghost Pirate|Ghost Pirate]]. Going by the name of Governor [[User:Ghost Pirate|Girum Rivclaw]] he was and still is the most recognisable Governor to lead the kingdom.

### Military

For a full list of ranks [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates/Ranks|click here]].

[[Image:Login_server_kingdoms2.png|thumb|right]]
#### Navy
The current leader of the [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates|Crescent Pirates]] fleet is Admiral [[User:Gothika|Naithaniel Lionheart]].
<br>The [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates|Crescent Pirates]] navy is the most noticeable, and deadliest force under the command of [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates|Crescent Pirates]].
<br>The Pirate navy never shys away from a challenge is always the victor due to superior numbers and skill.
Their navy has often be branched out into various crews. Such as the Phoenix Crew, lead by once great Admiral [[User:Raziel|Raziel Nasar]] and his brother [[User:Cheops|Cheops]]. Not to mention the devastating Tornado Squadron, founded and lead by Commander [[User:myth-simba|Chris Steele]].
<br>The Tornado Squadron was a group of selected elite boat battlers. Who were the first in and last out in navy warfare.
<br>The squad consisted of: [[User:myth-simba|Chris Steele]], [[User:Eric Polegato|Eric Steele]], [[User:Gothika|Naithaniel Lionheart]], [[User:cyan3|Felix Lionheart]] and [[User:Zeltino|Zeltino Zanza]].

#### Blood Raiders
The Blood Raiders act as body guards to the leaders of the [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates|Crescent Pirates]] while ruthlessly rooting out and eliminating any threat to the kingdom.. The Blood Raiders specialise in making enemies vanish without a trace and killing foes without a mark. <br>This small group of warriors are trained in many aspects including melee combat, archery, Alchemistry, Wizardy and Religious arts, mind manipulation, battle field tactics, use of plagues and poisons, impersonation and disguises, sailing and naval warfare, silent movement and breaking into enemy territory, and escape and concealment.

<br>The Blood Raiders are a small group committed to the protection of the kingdom inside and out. They are ready to serve the kingdom from doing a mission into enemy territory to guarding royalty in their voyages.

<br>The Blood Raiders follow the battle field tactic of causing chaos in the enemy ranks. This is done by poison, plagues, magic and out right blood frenzies. Thus how they got their name. They also use traps and ambushes for assassination and also use potions that would cause great pain on its victims.

### Towns
#### Pirton
Pirton is the capital town on Crescent Isle. It is located east of the castle.  Pirton is the only town on Crescent Isle where you can purchase a house flag.
Pirton also holds the card room and a rum maker.
<br>Pirton is the best defended town of the island as the war room resides there. Being at the centre of Crescent it is the most protected from a boat attack and it has multiple docks there ready for boats to scramble and intercept incoming threats. Also being a short walk away from the castle it is easy to re-enforce the town.
<br>Pirton was also known as Traders Row and still is referred to by that name by some.
<br>Previous Mayors of this town are [[User:Sam|Sam Schlurf]], [[User:Nature2|Maroku Dibides]], [[User:BigBear3|Padraig Lionheart]] and [[User:woofer102000|Paul Dibides]].

#### Westford
[[Image:CrescentPiratesWestford.png|thumb|left]]
Westford is located on the north-west of the island. It's where the ferry comes to from Hotaru.
<br>The Business Strip or Shop District as some call it is located in Westford. Many Pirates have set up shop selling various loot they've purchased or pillaged.
<br>In Westford you can craft a hook, the weapon of choice for some pirates. As well as fortifications and wall to be used to defend the castle and towns in the times of war.
<br>Retired Governor [[User:cyan3|Felix Lionheart]] was one Mayor of the town. Along Commander [[User:sage_scooby|Sage Cypher]] and Commodore [[User:blueyesto1|Blue Zakuto]].






#### Milton
[[Image:CrescentPiratesMilton.png|thumb|left]]
Milton is the town in he south-east of Crescent Isle. The Retired Governor [[User:Cruchot|Yannick Steele]] was once Mayor of Milton, aswell as Commodore [[User:protozero|Proto Steele]].
<br>In this there is a woodcutter and a mill to turn your corn into flour. In this town you can craft furniture for your house or  or get your hair done in the hairdressers.






#### Rum Town
Rum Town is the town in the south of the Isle. In Rum Town there are market stalls for people to sell their unwanted items and make some money. It Is also home to a spar arena and pub owned by Chef Steele. Naturally It has a rum maker there too.
<br>[[User:Zeltino|Zeltino Zanza]] was once Mayor of this great town, as well as Jack Steele and [[User:smokeraider|Cell Darkblade Zakuto]]. [[User:cbk1994|Chris Zakuto]] was also mayor for a short time.
<br>The town currently has a Mayor [[User:MLKJHP|Florent Easton]] to run it, assisted by [[User:Rastin100|Boris Easton]].

#### Ghoul Town
[[Image:CrescentPiratesGhoulTown.jpg|thumb|left|Screenshot of Ghoul Town on the 14th of January 2008.]]
Ghoul town is located on Ghoul Island, the small island to the north of Crescent Isle. On the island there is a Pirate Fort used for training their deadly Blood Raiders. The town is home to the famous Sinkin' Ship Tavern with the well-known Bar Brawl that occupies the top floor. This has been the hotspot for many [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates|Crescent Pirate]] events. 
<br>On this town there resides ghosts of dead Pirates as well as their Mayor Grisby Howl.
<br>In Ghoul Town you can craft the pirate hook in the blacksmiths.

Ghoul Town was uploaded on to [[worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] on the 14th of [[News/2008/January|January]] 2008.

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates/Article of Agreement

[[Category:Crescent Pirates]]

### Introduction
All Pirates must accept the terms of the Article of Agreement before joining the [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Crescent Pirates|Crescent Pirates]].

### Rules

* Do not use foul language on kingdom tag.
* Do not harass or be racist even off kingdom tag.
* No player killing on kingdom tag unless it is in defence or accepted by a leader.
* No scamming or stealing even kingdom tag.
* No short hand on kingdom tag (eg. k, ur, thx, nty, plz ect).
* Help other Pirates when requested by a leader.
* You should act in a respectable manner while on tag.
* Participate in kingdom events when on kingdom tag.
* Say Ahoy mates when joining on kingdom tag and Farewell mates when leaving.
* Respect persons with a higher rank.
* Use roleplaying while on kingdoms tag.
* You must use a full RP name when kingdoms tag (first and second name).
* Do not spoil or make fun of other pirates roleplay.
* Don't trade pirate items out of the kingdom.

### Punishments
* Pillory for 10 - 20 minutes depending on the rule broken.
* Demotion in rank.
* In the worst case removal and blacklisted from the kingdom.

### Other Rules
In addition to these rules you also need to follow the Graal Kingdoms Rules and the Graal Online Code of Conduct.
* [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Rules|Graal Kingdoms Rules]]
* [http://www.graalonline.com/docs/conduct.php Code of Conduct]

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Enchant Armour

[[Category:Graal Kingdoms Guides]]
{{Under Construction|author=[[User:Cyan3|Felix Lionheart]]}}

### Introduction
Armour can be enchanted using Enchant Armour scrolls which can be used to improve the base value of stats on armours such as helmets, shields, cloaks, bracers, body armour, boots, and gloves. The only values that will improve are Weapon Class (wc), Armour Class (ac), and Damage (dam) improving by + 1 for each scroll, Armour is also increased with the use of the scrolls but increases by more than +1 with each scroll and to the max value of 90 on most items.

### Improvement Table
To view the improvement table [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Enchant Armour/Improvement Table|click here]].

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Events

[[Category:Graal Kingdoms]]
=Card and Cube Games=
[[File:card_room.jpg|thumb|left|[[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]] Card Room]]
[[File:cube.jpg|thumb|right|Graal Kingdoms Cube Room]]

#### Black Jack
#### Even/Odd
The object of Even or Odd cube game is to successfully guess if the dice is going to be even or odd. Event Masters will roll the dice and if the player successfully guesses all cards right, they advance to the next round until there are 2 contestants left. The last player who guesses correctly is then given a prize.

#### Hi/Low
The object of Higher or Lower card game is to successfully guess if the next faced-down card is going to be higher or lower than the previous faced-up card.     Players are given 5 cards with the first one flipped up. Event Masters will determine if the Ace card is either valued at 1 or 11 at the start of the event. If the player successfully guesses all cards right, they advance to the next round until there are 3 contestants left. The last three players are then given prizes according to who comes in first, second, or third.

=Spars=
[[File:Hotaru_Spar.jpg|thumb|left|Hotaru Spar Arena]]

#### Bognera Spar

#### Bomboria Spar
Bomboria spar is most commonly know to be used as a magic only spar. Although all weapons are allowed in these event. Events Masters can limit the weapons that are allowed during the event. The Events Master will set the rules for the event and the last man standing will be the prize winner of this event.

#### Close Encounters
[[File:Close_Encounters.jpg|thumb|right|Close Encounter Spar Arena]]
This spar is similar to the other spars beside one thing. In this spar you are very limited on the amount of space you have so it can become a challenge. You are able to use all weapons and you are also able to use your spells in this spar. Death seems to appear much faster in this spar then the rest. The last man standing is the winner of this event.

#### Hotaru Spar
The object of the Hotaru Spar is to have a melee-oriented brawl. The object of the event is to fight participants until there is one player left. Event Masters can choose which weapons are enabled and what status-effects are allowed throughout the fight. Remember magic WILL NOT work in the Hotaru Arena. The rules will be stated at the beginning of each spar.

#### Kingdom Core
[[File:Kingdom_Core.jpg|thumb|right|Graal Kingdoms Core]]
Kingdoms Core is for kingdom members only. You will be able to fight other kingdoms in this event. Dont forget that you can start it yourself with your kingdom! There are two Kingdom Cores that are usually hosted on Graal Kingdoms. Kingdom Core events can be started to have a friendly battle with another Kingdom or it can be started when different Kingdoms are ready for War. When the Kingdoms go to War there are stakes involved. The Kingdom that wins the war will take over the other Kingdom and pick the leader of his choosing.

=Sports=
[[File:hockey.jpg|thumb|left|Ice Hocket]]
[[File:soccer.jpg|thumb|right|Soccer]]

### Soccer

### Hockey

Event Information Added Soon.



=Other Events=
[[File:altars.jpg|thumb|left|Lucky Alters]]

#### Lucky Altars
In this event there are 8 platforms. Each round 1-4 platforms will be chosen to be the correct answer. If you're on the correct platform you will stay alive, however, if you're not on the correct platform by the time it's called, you will lose a life.Once you reach 0 lives and you're out! Last man standing will be the winner of the event and will receive a prize.

#### Musical Chairs
In Musical Chairs players are asked to move in a direction the Event Master states before starting. Players will keep moving in the direction until the Event Master says :stop. When the Event Master say so, a random amount of chairs will appear in random areas around the center area. whoever that does not make it to a chair will be kicked and another round will start. players will keep playing until there is one player left. Event Masters can change the rules, so pay attention.

#### Kart Race

#### Emoticons
All players should be standing in the same area (Usually at the top of the level in a line). The Events Master will then use a emoticon (CTRL + "_") Example: CTRL+O . Players will copy the emoticon, the last person to copy the emoticon is eliminated from the event, these steps should be repeated until only one player is left. The last player left wins the event.

#### Waterglass
The key to Waterglass is a steady movement of the mouse! Come try your skills in the waterglass event and try to balance the water in the center of the glass.

#### Raffle

#### I Spy
In this event, the Events Master will says "I spy with my little eye something that is... (color/characteristics)"
Players will race to be the first person to guess the item correctly. Everyone participating should pm the answers to the Events Master. While doing this event the Events Master needs to check the times on private messages to ensure he/she chooses the FIRST person to send message is acknowledged and is given a point. The Events Master should have chose a certain amount of points that a player needs to win this event at the beginning of the event. When a player has obtained the needed points, they win.
[[File:Waterglass.jpg|thumb|left|Waterglass]]
[[File:ispy.jpg|thumb|left|I-Spy]]

#### Double Dice
Double Dice is a gambling event set in the Bomboria trade house. To start the event each player is required to place an event cube on either side of the table  to claim ownership and is then followed by the bets. Players can stake any of their items on the table to gamble. After bets have been placed they need to be confirmed by double clicking on the cube. This will start the roll and the dice with the largest number wins all the items on the losing side of the table. If matching numbers occur the dice will roll again.

Any item can be removed from the table by double clicking but only before both sides have been confirmed, after the confirmation the bets are final and can't be reverted.
[[Image:Double Dice.png|thumb|left|Double Dice]]
