## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Kingdom/Ackbar

[[Category:Graal Kingdoms]][[Category:Roleplaying]]
Ackbar was a series of events where the Kingdom of [[Dustari]] was utterly destroyed by a suprise attack by [[Samurai]], [[Pirate Crew]], [[Karakaze Troupe]], and there were even reports of members of the [[Zormite]] Empire fighting the battle.

The destruction of Ackbar occured when Dustari's Regent, King Kamuii Nightrose, was invited to a peace talk with the Karakaze Troupe. Unlucky for the Dustarian King he sat on a trap seat which jettisoned spikes upwards to impale the bomy with the immortal words '''"Ackbar"'''

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/New Player Guide

[[Category:Graal Kingdoms Guides]]
=Q Menu=
The Q menu is divided into several sections. Hold down Q or left-click the player to open this menu.

The left column is divided into 3 sections. The top bar tells the player's level and current experience. The player's level will increase as the player gains more experience. Killing monsters, reading books, and identifying items are just some of the ways you can gain more experience.

The section beneath that shows the character's attributes. Move the mouse over an attribute icon to see the name of that attribute. Note that as your weight increases, your speed decreases. Don't carry too much stuff!

Third, we have the Skill/Experience section. Your character has six skill areas in which he or she may level up. The number on the left represents your level in that skill area, and the number on the right represents your current experience in that level. Individual skill areas follow the same rules as overall character level when leveling up. See "Experience" for more information.

The bottom section on the left side is the Resistances area. This lists your resistance to various kinds of attacks and spells. Move the mouse over each icon to see what it represents.

The top-right side of the Q menu is divided into 2 sections. The equipment section shows what items you have equipped, and what part of the body they are equipped to. The right-most section displays the name and statistics of the currently selected item.

The bottom-right section is your inventory. On the left side you see the main portion of your inventory. Here you may select, drag, wield, or apply your items.

On the right side you see the special inventory area. This is where you may view and manipulate the contents of containers such as the cauldron or sack.

To drop an item, drag it from the inventory to the ground outside of the Q menu. 

Currently cannot drop items properly on the outside of ships.

=Stat Bars=
On the upper-right corner of the screen you see a graphic with four stat bars. These represent, from top to bottom:

### Health Bar (HP)
Displays Current Health / Maximum Health

How much life you have left. When you hit 0, you die (Bad, bad idea!). Slowly refills over time. Leveling up in overall character level will increase your maximum HP.

### Spell Points (SP)
Displays Current Spell Points / Maximum Spell Points

How many spell points (also known as mana) you have left. Slowly refills over time. Leveling up in Magic will increase your maximum SP.

### Grace
Displays Current Grace / Maximum Grace

How much grace you have. You can refill grace by praying to your god. You need to have learned Piety before you are able to pray.

### Food
Displays Food Level (up to 999 food)

How much food you have eaten. Slowly drains. You must eat food or other edible
items to refill. When it reaches zero, you start eating random items from your
inventory. When you have nothing left to eat, you die (Bad, bad idea).

=Quick-Launch Menu=
Below the stat bars, there are three buttons. Clicking on one of these buttons will open up its quick menu. On each menu you see a list of the skills, weapons, or spells that you have. You may double-click or middle-click on any icon to use/wield that skill/weapon/spell. You may also drag a spell icon to an object to use the spell on that object (if supported).

### Hotkeys
Highlight an icon on any menu, then click the blank space to the right of it.  Press a number key, W, E, R, T, or C to assign that key to the icon. Then, pressing that key is the same as double-clicking the icon on the quick menu.

=Experience=
The player begins at level 1. Level 2 requires 2000 experience, level 3 requires 4000, and so on, with the necessary experience doubling each time (2000, 4000, 8000, etc).

If you are killed by monsters or by another player (outside of a spar arena), you will lose a certain amount of experience. If you lose enough experience, you may also drop to a lower character level.

=Advanced Movement and Transportation=
### Walking
Walking is influenced by the character's weight and the terrain. The more weight you have in your inventory, the slower you walk. You also walk slowly going uphill.

### Swimming
Swimming involves walking into the water, then pressing S to stroke while steering with arrow keys.

### Ships
Ships are the only way to visit the kingdom islands! You may board a ship at a dock, from another ship, or if no one is on board you may swim onto the ship.  Walk to the captain's wheel and press A to take the controls. Hold S to accelerate the ship while steering with the arrow keys. Press A to leave the wheel. The person steering can say "setname shipname" where shipname is what he wants to name the ship!

You may also touch the mast and press A to climb to the crow's nest. While
up here you can use the arrow keys to look around. Press A to get down.

Touch a cannon and press A to fire an exploding cannonball.

Ships may be damaged in fights or wear out over time. If you're carrying
boards, walk to a wall of the ship and press A to repair it.

=Kingdoms=
You may see players with kingdom ranks and tags. The five kingdoms are:

1. Forest
1. Pirates (aka Crescent Pirates)
1. Zormite
1. Dustari
1. Samurai (aka Bakugun)

To join a kingdom you have to ask the kingdom leader. PM a kingdom member
to find out who that is.

To travel to the kingdom isles, get on a ship and go to the edges of the
mainmap (the island with monsters on it). On the minimap, you see icons:

* Tree - Forest
* Fish - Zormite
* Sword - Dustari
* Skull/crossbones - Pirate
* Samurai hat - Samurai

Leave the map near these icons to travel to that kingdom's isles. From time to time you might hit the wrong spot and travel to a different kingdom. You can travel from one kingdom to another the same way. On the kingdom isle maps, a gold cup points the way back to the mainmap.

=Items and Food=
Items are usually pretty simple. Once you have one equipped (double-click to equip), press S to use it.

Food is a little different. To eat food, simply double-click it. You may eat bread, food (looks like meat), onions, potatoes, water, and many other things. Not all items are edible, and not all edible items are healthy!

Double-click containers to activate, open, or close them. A container that is opened will show an icon at the top of the "container" section of the Q menu. Use this on mailboxes, too.

To get more information on an item, right-click it. On the bottom-right of your screen you will see an item description, often including:
* Item name
* Effect of using the item (such as how much food it gives you)
* What the item is made of
* Weight
* Sell Price
* and other attributes.

Some items, like certain weapons, may be used in different ways. Use combinations of S, arrow keys, and D to discover other ways of using the item.

=Commands=
Commands must be typed into the chat bar with a / in front of them.

Type '''/help commands''' to discover many common commands.

Type '''/help (command)''' to find out information on a specific command.

The '''/save command''' is good for immediately backing up your progress, to make sure you don't lose items if the server messes up or you disconnect from
Graal.  Similar to /save is the automatic function of beds, docks, and dungeon doors:  when you enter a bed or a dungeon, or walk to the end of a dock, your restart position is saved (which means if you die, you start there instead of having to restart your character!).

=Fun Stuff=
* Use the shovel to dig on beaches, you might find a metris game. Equip it and press S to play. Use arrow keys to steer the bones, use S to rotate them. Press A to quit.
* Touch a palm tree and press A to climb to the top. You can look around as though you were on top of a ship's mast!
* Touch an upright, open, empty barrel and press A to climb inside and close it behind you! Press A to get out again.

=Frequently Asked Questions=
### How do I get ... seed?
Craft a shovel and dig.

### How do I plant corn?
Place the corn seed on the ground and double-click it. Be sure to water it every time it shows the water symbol.

### How do I plant trees?
Place the tree seed on '''grass''' and double-click it.  No water necessary.

### How do I get more spell points?
Use a spell to kill lots of creatures until you level up in Magic.

### The anvil just ate my hot iron!
When you touch the anvil, press S instead of A.

### Why can't I craft on a black anvil?
See above.

### Where do I get bomy skins?
Kill bomies. Lots of bomies. The regular or evil ones.

### Will somebody give me food?
'''NO'''. Food is something we all need (unless we worship Bile) and never get enough of. Ask individuals near you very nicely and you may get lucky, but please, don't PM. It's annoying. It helps if you're willing to pay/trade. If nothing else, go play with a water can for about 10 minutes or so and refill your foodbar by drinking a lot.

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Prepare Weapon

[[Category:Graal Kingdoms Guides]]
{{Under Construction|author=[[User:Cyan3|Felix Lionheart]]}}

### Introduction
This guide will explain the basics of preparing and improving weapons of [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms|Graal Kingdoms]].

### Preparing
To prepare a weapon you first need to find or buy a prepare weapon scroll and decide how many slots you are willing to open on the weapon. These slots can to used to add improvements to the weapon. The number of slots that can be used on a weapon is based on the users physique level. At level 1 physique the number of slots that can be used is 5 which increases by 1 every 5 physique levels. For example at level 5 physique the user can handle 6 slots and at level 10 can handle 7 slots.

Here is an example of a prepared weapon:
<br>
[[Image:Mud bsword54.png]] cyan3's Tainted Grace of Govannon +9 (Con+1)(dam+79)(improved 15/15)(slay demon)(Attacks:physical, weaponmagic, blinding) 

The first thing to notice on the weapon is the account name of the person who prepared it. This means that only the person who prepared the weapon can use the  weapon, in this case only cyan3 can use the weapon. The second addition to the weapon is Consitution + 1 and damage + 79, these are the improvements used on the weapon and finally (improved 15/15) which indicates the maximum slots on the weapon and how many are filled. It is important to note that a weapon can be prepared with more slots than the user can handle and still be used providing that the slots filled on the weapon is the same or lower than the user can handle. For example if a weapon were improved to handle 7 slots but the user only has a physique level of 1, the weapon could be improved with 5 improvements with the extra 2 slots left over until the user wishes to fill them.

### Improvement Table
To view the improvement table [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Prepare Weapon/Improvement Table|click here]].

### Using Improvements

#### Prepare Weapon Scroll
To apply an Improve Weapon Damage Scroll to a prepared weapon simply say /mark <weaponname> (for example /mark cyan3's Tainted Grace) then place the amount of diamonds on the ground needed to improve the weapon ([[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Prepare Weapon/Improvement Table|click here]] to see the improvement table), then double click on the scroll.

#### Improve Weapon Damage Scroll
To apply an Improve Weapon Damage Scroll to a prepared weapon simply say /mark <weaponname> (for example /mark cyan3's Tainted Grace) then double click on the scroll.

#### Enchant Weapon Scroll
To apply an Enchant Weapon Scroll to a prepared weapon simply say /mark <weaponname> (for example /mark cyan3's Tainted Grace) then double click on the scroll.

#### Improve Stat Bonus Scrolls
'''Note:''' This will apply for all improve stat scrolls from improve Strength to improve Charisma.
<br><br>
Improve stat scrolls work differently than Improve Weapon Damage and Enchant Weapon Scrolls as [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Prepare Weapon#Potions|Stat potions]] are needed to improve the weapon.

To apply an Improve Stat Bonus Scrolls to a prepared weapon simply say /mark <weaponname> (for example /mark cyan3's Tainted Grace) then place the potions on  the ground, then double click on the scroll.

##### Stat Potion Multiplier
The multiplier for Improve Stat Bonus is 2 potions for +1, another 2 potions for +2, 4 potions for +3, 6 potions for +4, 8 potions for +5, 10 potions for +6 and so on.

An example would be if you were going to improve an Ice Dagger with +2 strength and +1 dexterity. It will take 2 strength potions for +1 strength, another 2 strength potions for +2 strength, and 4 dexterity potions for +1 dexterity. If y you then decide to add another +1 dexterity it will use 6 potions, then 8 potions, then 10 and so on.

'''Note:''' Even if you place more potions than is needed to improve the weapon it will still use the extra potions regardless.

### Prepare Items
Certain items can be used to prepare and improve weapons each giving a different effect.

#### Scrolls
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Prepare Weapon''' - Used to prepare a weapon
<br>
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Improve Weapon Damage''' - Used to improve the damage inflicted by a weapon.
<br>
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Enchant Weapon''' - Used to enchant the weapon with an extra blessing (for example Govannon + 9 to Govannon + 10).
<br>
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Improve Strength Bonus''' - Used to improve Strength on a weapon using Strength potions.
<br>
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Improve Dexterity Bonus''' - Used to improve Dexterity on a weapon using Dexterity potions.
<br>
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Improve Constitution Bonus''' - Used to improve Constitution on a weapon using Constitution potions.
<br>
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Improve Intelligence Bonus''' - Used to improve Intelligence on a weapon using Intelligence potions.
<br>
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Improve Wisdom Bonus''' - Used to improve Intelligence on a weapon using Wisom potions.
<br>
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Improve Power Bonus''' - Used to improve Power on a weapon using Power potions.
<br>
[[Image:Mud scroll.png]] '''Improve Charisma Bonus''' - Used to improve Charisma on a weapon using Charisma potions.

#### Potions
[[Image:Mud potionstr.png]] '''Strength Potion''' - Used with Improve Strength Bonus scroll to improve Strength on a weapon.
<br>
[[Image:Mud potiondex.png]] '''Dexterity Potion''' - Used with Improve Dexterity Bonus scroll to improve Dexterity on a weapon.
<br>
[[Image:Mud potioncon.png]] '''Constitution Potion''' - Used with Improve Constitution Bonus scroll to improve Constitution on a weapon.
<br>
[[Image:Mud potionint.png]] '''Intelligence Potion''' - Used with Improve Intelligence Bonus scroll to improve Intelligence on a weapon.
<br>
[[Image:Mud potionwis.png]] '''Wisdom Potion''' - Used with Improve Wisdom Bonus scroll to improve Wisdom on a weapon.
<br>
[[Image:Mud potionpow.png]] '''Power Potion''' - Used with Improve Power Potion Bonus scroll to improve Power Potion on a weapon.
<br>
[[Image:Mud potioncha.png]] '''Charisma Potion''' - Used with Improve Charisma Bonus scroll to improve Charisma on a weapon.

#### Gems
[[Image:Mud gem.png]] '''Diamond''' - Used with the Prepare Weapon scroll to prepare a weapon.

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Quests

[[Category:Graal Kingdoms Guides]]
{{spoiler}}

=Trading=
For up to date information on who needs what items and what their rewards are, visit the '''Misty Mug Tavern''' in '''Bomboria''' and check out the bulletin board behind the counter.

### Items
#### Battle Mushroom Lord Spore
* Trade the [[Image:Mud_spore.png|Battle Mushroom Lord Spore]] '''Battle Mushroom Lord Spore''' for a [[Image:Mud_magnifier.png|Magnifying Glass]] '''Magnifying Glass''' from Shuki Oppenheimer in the upper store of Tanarthia.

#### Cartographer
* Trade the '''Cartographer''' for a [[Image:Mud_gizmocover.png|Gizmo Cover]] '''Gizmo Cover''' from the eccentric in '''Pirton''' on Pirates island.

#### Clockwork
* Trade the [[Image:Mud_clockwork.png|Clockwork]] '''Clockwork''' for a [[Image:Mud_cukoo.png|Cukoo]] '''Cukoo''' from anyone willing to part with one.

#### Evil Bomy Lord Horn
* Trade the [[Image:Mud_eblhorn.png|Evil Bomy Lord Horn]] '''Evil Bomy Lord Horn''' for a [[Image:Mud_meritbadge.png|Merit Badge]] '''Merit Badge''' from Erin Bonnie at the east coast of main island.

#### Earrings
* Trade the [[Image:Mud_silverearrings.png|Earrings]] '''Earrings''' for a [[Image:Mud_hankerchief.png|Hankerchief]] '''Hankerchief''' from the mayor of '''Avalonia''' or '''Harmonia'''.
* Trade the [[Image:Mud_silverearrings.png|Earrings]] '''Earrings''' for a [[Image:Mud_gsword13.png|Glass Sword]] '''Glass Sword''' from someone looking for something pointy.
* Trade the [[Image:Mud_silverearrings.png|Earrings]] '''Earrings''' for a [[Image:Mud_carving1.png|Glok Carving]] '''Glok Carving''' from someone looking for something pointy.

#### Glass Sword
* Trade the [[Image:Mud_gsword13.png|Glass Sword]] '''Glass Sword''' for a [[Image:Mud_dragonpearl.png|Dragon Pearl]] '''Dragon Pearl''' from the adept in '''Hotaru'''.

#### Glok Lord Ectoplasm
* Trade the [[Image:Mud_ectoplasm.png|Glok Lord Ectoplasm]] '''Glok Lord Ectoplasm''' for a [[Image:Mud_potion_util.png|Universal Solvent]] '''Universal Solvent''' from man in the southern shop in '''Bogenera'''.

#### Hankerchief

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Spells Guide

[[Category:Graal Kingdoms Guides]]
### Spell casting

With the update on February 24 of 2006 the spell casting has been drastically improved to allow targetting via mouse. Following things have been changed:
* you can select if you want to cast by mouse or into the direction you are viewing
* click on a target to target it or move the mouse over it while casting a spell
* press A or the right mouse key to unlock the target
* double-click to directly cast the prepared spell
* the new targetting mode is also working with hotkeys and scrolls
* when you are not casting via mouse then you can cast diagonally now

### Spell types

This is overview about the different spell types on Graal Kingdoms.

#### Missiles

Missiles are single projectiles flying at a good speed. They can be targetted 
at players and monsters and are then following those. Most of the time they
are not very strong and disappear after about 15 seconds, but since they can
be targetted at moving objects they can be quite usefull. 

Some missiles have special effects:
* missiles like ball lightning are bouncing off walls 
* fireballs and several other balls are exploding once they hit a wall and then produce a fire or similar on the ground

#### Cones

Cone spells are producing 3 missiles, that way they can cover a bigger area and
might be good against a group of enemies. You can shoot them in any direction,
they will not follow the target though. 

Some cone spells leave stuff on their paths:
vitriol splash missiles are placing acid on their path, the spider web spell
is placing spider webs.

#### Bolts

Bolts are basicly lines of spell effects which are placed into the direction you
are casting. The length of the line depends on your stats. The spell effects
stay for a few seconds and are attacking objects that are on the same place. They
don't move but can be quite strong.

#### Walls

Walls are lines of spell effects placed in front of the caster,
1 in front, 5 to the left and 5 to the right. There are various spells using
this formation, using fire, ice, stones and thorns.

#### Auras

Auras are following the caster and protect him/her for a few seconds. The duration
depends on the level of the caster. The auras are not very strong but don't 
require you to do anything once casted, they attack surrounding monsters until the 
aura disappears. 
Currently there is only the flaming aura and sanctuary (counter-spell aura).

#### Smite

The smite spells try to find a target near and attack it directly (sometimes
without visual effect).

#### Spell walls

Spell walls either influence the direction of flying spells (directors) 
or are shooting themself automatically missiles. You will need the earth-to-dust
spell to destroy these.

#### Runes

Runes are placed in front of the caster and have a size of 8x8 tiles. For some minutes
they are only visible to the caster. They work like a trap and explode once a monster
or a non-peaceful player walks on them. Runes can contain all kind of spells
which are either casted on the trapped player or monster, or into the direction the
caster was looking when he/she placed the rune.
There are several skills which handle runes: for finding traps and disarming them.

#### Golems

The golem spells include the golem spell itself, but also the elementals,
staff-to-snake, dancing sword, mystic fist, animated weapon and summon avatar. 
They are placed in front of the caster, you can only have one of them at 
the same time. They are walking or flying into the direction the caster is looking,
so they can be directly controlled without putting the caster into a risky sitation.
The 'golems' are automatically attacking players on monsters that pass their way.

When using the 'animated weapon' spell then it is taking your weapon away, but placing
it back into your inventory once its lifetime is over.

#### Summoning monsters

There are a few spells for summoning monsters, some are disabled though until we have
added a bigger variation of monster types. The summoned monsters use your nickname
and are attacking enemies on their way. There is a special flute song to make the
summoned monsters stop following you.

#### Changing attributes

There is a wide variation of spells which temporary change your or the victims attributes.
Those can be for improving stats (e.g. charm or strength), resistance 
(against poison, fire etc.), or increasing your speed. Some of those spells also
heal you, are removing flags (e.g. confusion), cure illnesses or regenerate
spell points (but using grace).

#### Illnesses

The illness system on Graal Kingdoms is quite complex: there are illnesses which
can jump from player to player or monster to monster and infect a big group of
objects, like in real life. They often have funny effects, like losing tooths,
but can also decrease your stats or hurt you. They only last a limited time and
can be cured by spells. 
Illnesses have different levels depending on the casters level. People that have
survived an illnesses wear an immunity against the illness as long as it's the
same level or below. They will be infected again if the same illness strikes 
back with a higher level.

#### Identification

Spells can also be used to identify an object, and find curses or similar.

#### Creation

Some spells can be used to create special objects: 
You can create food, you will get more food depending on your level. 
You can use alchemy to transform items into gold or use recipes on the 
items you have put in a cauldron.

#### Others

There are a few spells which are special and cannot be put in one of the
mentioned categories.
Those spells include 'earth to dust' which can destroy spell walls, or the
'wonder' spell which fires a random book spell.


### Fixed spells

Most spells have been modified to look better, be able to
target players and monsters and hit more precise. There are 
a few spells with special effects:

#### Slow

The slow spell is a cone spell, which fires 3 flying clocks which slow down
objects on their path. This is now working for monsters too.

#### Spiderweb

The spider web spell is a cone spell, three spiders are running away and are 
spinning a web on their path. Walking on those webs are slowing you down.
The effect lasts for about 8 seconds.

#### Counterspell & counterwall

The counter spell is removing spell effects. It is possible now to also
remove spell effects of higher level, with a lower chance of course.
Counter walls can be an effective protection against incoming missiles.

#### Sanctuary

Sanctuary is an aura spell and is protecting you against other spell effects
for some time. It is not very strong though so it might not block 100% of
the magic around you.

#### Magic Missile

The magic missiles are now actually displaying something: they are white
missiles which produce a lot of black smoke. They are flying in a random
direction and can even come back after some time.

#### Wall of thorns

The wall of thorns is not very powerful but still interesting, since it is
slowing players down when they try to pass the thorns, and it is also
hurting (physicially only though).

#### Earth wall

The earth wall spells puts some stones in front of you, so effectively
blocking enemies for a few moments.

#### Create food

The create food can still produce random food depending on your level.
By typing '/cast create food <FOODNAME>' you can also produce specific
food, if your level is high enough for that food.

#### Marking rune

Marking runes finally make some sense: Type 'cast marking rune <text>' to
place a sign which is displaying text of maximum 20 characters. You can
recast the spell to place several marking runes. 
The marking runes are not lasting long though, they can easily be destroyed
by using weapons on them. In opposition to the other runes the marking
runes are actually staying though even after you log out.

#### Insect plague

The insect plague is a smite spell which is displaying an effect now
(and playing a bees sound).

#### Wonder

The wonder spell is not available by scrolls/books/gods, but might be
available via quests or events soon (by spell scrolls). It is casting
a random book spell.

#### Director

The director is changing the direction of missiles, cone spells
and bolts which are hitting the director. The graphics for the director
might be changed soon though to look better and bigger. Also there 
will need to be a protection so that they cannot be placed in front
of doors to block those, since you need the earth-to-dust spell which
not every player has.


### Non-working spells

There are a few spells which are not working right now or
don't make sense.

#### Light & Night

There is currently no system of limited vision (except in the labyrinth event),
that's why the spells for blinding by light, producing night and similar
are currently not doing anything.
Also it is not possible to make yourself invisible yet, although that might
be interesting, at least in dungeons.

#### Summon cult monster

We plan to add a wider variation of monster types, until then it will not
make a lot of sense to summon monsters which actually have no connection
to the Graal Kingdom gods you are praying to.

#### Spells targetting undeads

There are several spells for slaying undeads, while there are not many
undead monsters on Graal Kingdoms yet. This might change once we have added
more monster types, like zombies.

#### Create missile

The 'create missile' spell is generating arrows with magical bonus. The bows and
crossbows currently don't use those magical effects though. It will be interesting
in the future to use the magical bows which can be equipped in addition to a 
normal weapon and use the magical arrows for hitting other objects.

### Non-available spells

There are a few spells which are neither avilable via scrolls, books nor via
praying to a god. Those spells are:
Wonder, small speedball, medium speedball, hellfire, dragonbreath, large icestorm, 
shockwave, color spray, meteor storm, comet, vitriol splash.
We plan to eventually put scrolls with limited charges of them in quest dungeons.

To read the concise version of the Start Island Guide [[Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Start Island Guide/Concise|click here]].

### A New Adventure

#### Dialogue

##### Joseph
Hello! My wife has already informed me of the arrival of a new Traveller. You probably have no clue about Graal Kingdoms, the people and the rules? You can probably learn some things by helping some of my friends. Here is a list of people needing help, just click on the map icon on the left side of the screen, then select an option, and you will arrive there. They will teach you how to use items, buying things in shops and learning Magic. Once you have completed everything come in my pub and I will tell you more. It is a few steps east of here.

Live long and prosper!

#### Changing look
You can change your look by clicking on the the male and female bodies with your mouse.

#### Quest Interface
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startnewadventurequest.png|250px|thumb|right|Quest Interface]]
The quest interface displays all the quests you have left to complete and can be used to warp to the location of any quest by clicking on the quest name with your mouse.

### Feeding Pet
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startfeedingpet.png|250px|thumb|left|Sea side Farm]]
#### Dialogue

##### Nancy
Hello! My little Choupa pet is not here anymore, I cannot find it. Please bring it back to me! First you need to feed it with an apple, just drop this apple. Then you need to play a melody with the flute to let the pet follow you, Equip it by double-clicking on it in the menu, then press S/D to hold, then >v^>V^<V. Then bring it back to me please.

#### Guide
To complete this quest simply drop the apple on the ground and wait for the pet to start eating it, then play the melody Nancy asked you to play S/D>v^>V^<V. The pet will then follow you back to Nancy.



### Visit Wizard

[[Image:Graalkingdoms startvisitwizard.png|250px|thumb|left|Enter the Wizards house.]]
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startvisitwizardmagicinfo.png|250px|thumb|right|Learn from the books.]]

#### Dialogue

##### Gand the Wizard
see my mighty spell!

##### Magic Info
We are teaching magic. Grab the objects on the tables and I will tell you some interesting things about them. You can buy most things required for magic in the magic shops on the main island. The only thing you need is some basic level of wisdom and intelligence, without them you should not try to be a magician. There is black and white magic. Black magic (Sorcerer) can be learned from books and scrolls and require spell points (mana), while white magic is given you by your god. Prayers only work by grace of God.

##### Magic Book
That is a spell book, when you read it you might learn the spell written in it, but you need to have high intelligence or must be of higher level than the spell.

##### Prayer Book
That is like a spell book, but instead of normal spells it gives you the knowledge of using a special prayer when you succeed in reading it. You must have the praying skill and follow a god to use this. To follow a god just go to one of the 5 altars on the main island and pray.

##### Skill Scroll
This scroll gives you a skill when you succeed in reading it. Skills can be quite powerful, e.g. praying opens many possibilities like getting healed by the god or using white magic, or literacy allows even Barbarians to read books and scrolls. Skill scrolls are quite expensive.

##### Magic Scroll
Scrolls give you the power to fire spells one time. That way you can test to see if a spell is good for you. Also some spells are only available as scrolls and cannot be learned, e.g. the weapon enhancement scroll which lets you power up your swords and axes.

##### Books
There are several books and papers that tell you something about how things work, such as recipes for alchemy and guides for fighting.

##### Wands info
To cast a spell or prayer you have 3 ways: You can equip a wand or rod and press S, you can activate a scroll by double-clicking it, or you can select spell in the quick=launch menu under the health bar and food bar. Double click on an icon or move the icon onto a player or monster to select the object you want to cast the spell on.

##### Wand
Wands give you limited charges for special black magic spells, you also need a wand equipped when you want to cast spells that are not bound to objects, basically all spells that appear in the quick launch spell list when you click on the "Spells" button under the health bar and food bar display.

##### Red Staffs
Red staffs give you limited charges of white magic spells (prayers)

##### Blue Rod
That type of rod gives unlimited charges of spells and is more expensive, but still needs spell points or grace so you must sometimes wait until those are restored.

#### Guide
To complete this quest talk to the npcs and leave the building.

### Buy Healing Potion
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startbuypotion.png|250px|thumb|left|Talk to Bonnie to start the quest.]]
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startbuypotionferry.png|250px|thumb|right|Take the ferry from Sea Side Farm to Bomboria.]]

#### Dialogue

##### Bonnie
Hello! Please help me, I was falling and injured my left leg. Please bring me a healing potion from the shop to the right side.

##### Potion Task
After a long time of thinking, I decided to move to Bomboria. No one came to my my potions anymore so I had to do something. I hope the people over there are looking for some potions - Jeno

##### Bonnie
Oh, I did not know that the potion shop moved to Bomboria . Please help me and get the potion from there. You can get to Bomboria using the ferry. At the Sea Side Farm is a dock where the ferry leaves. Good luck!

[[Image:Graalkingdoms startbuypotionshop.png|250px|thumb|left|Buy the potion from the store in Bomboria.]]
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startbuypotiontrade.png|250px|thumb|right|Trade the potion to Bonnie.]]
##### Swashbuckler Roy
Ahoy, what are you doing? ... Ah, I see - Yes I am waiting for the ferry, too. It is an important vehicle to travel from island to island. Usually you have to pay for the ferry but since there is no other way like a dungeon or a dockyard to build your own ship, this ferry is free t use

Enjoy your journey!

##### Jeno
Hello! I am selling special potions. Just go to one of the potions, then press the A key to see the "buy" menu. Click on the left button to buy it.

##### Bonnie
Please give me that healing potion! Open your item menu by pressing Q, then select the potion and move it on me so that you see the trading icon, then drop it. With the same way you can trade items with other players.

##### Bonnie
Many thanks!

That should help me a lot.

#### Guide
To complete this quest you have to travel to main land via the ferry at Sea Side Farm (Feeding Pet Task). Once you arrive at the main land head into town and enter the potion shop. In the potion shop press the A key on the blue healing potion and click the left button on the interface. When you have received the potion you have to head back to Bonnie who will be a waiting your arrival. To cure Bonnie drag the potion from your inventory over her until you see the trade icon then let go of your mouse button.

### Moving Furniture
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startmovingfurniturehouse.png|250px|thumb|left|Talk to Boris to start the quest.]]
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startmovingfurniturehouse2.png|250px|thumb|right|Enter the house.]]

#### Dialogue

##### Boris
Hello! I am building a new house, but somehow the stones fall out again once I finish the wall... Well, I have heard you wanted to help my wife Madeleine who is moving the furniture in our house(again...). The house is just a few steps to the west.

##### Madeleine
Hello! Can you help me? In my house I have a  lot of new furniture, someone needs to help to move them to the right places. Just enter the house and move some of my furniture by clicking them with the mouse, keep the mouse button pressed, and move it to another place, then release the button. All houses owned by Graalians have movable furniture, you just need to drop it on the ground and move it with the mouse, if you are the owner of the house.


[[Image:Graalkingdoms startmovingfurniture.png|250px|thumb|left|Move some Furniture inside the house.]]
#### Guide
Moving some furniture inside the house and then leave again to complete the quest.














### Using the Mines
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startmines.png|250px|thumb|left|Enter the mines.]]
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startminesrocks.png|250px|thumb|right|Talk to James.]]

#### Dialogue

##### Jimmy
Hello! Do you mind helping us in the mines? We have a big job to finish but we do not have enough time! Please go inside and talk to my older brother James.

##### James
Great to see my brother found someone who is able to help us! Mining is not hard at all but there are different way to do it. In the beginning while you have no equipment you can just kick the rocks in the mines holding the S key and pressing the direction keys (<v>v) in the direction you are facing to destroy them and get the coal, iron, gold or even diamonds. It takes some time but it works great without any equipment. But you have to be careful, sometimes hidden monsters appear so be quick and kill them.

Please go and get me some iron or coal now and I will tell you more!
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startminescrush.png|250px|thumb|left|Talk to Hank.]]
##### James
The other way to mine is to hit the rocks with a pickaxe. This way you are done faster. but there are  not only rocks, have a look around in the mines and you will see that some walls have cracks. If you use your pickaxe there then you will get some minerals out of the wall. You can pick these up and take them to the crusher. I have a few that need to be crushed, take them to Hank. He will tell you more about it.

##### Hank
Ah, finally more mineral! I hope these are not the only ones we've got!? Well - Please give me the mineral then I can put it in the crusher. It will destroy the stone and leave the good supplies. It is very easy. If you mine yourself later on all you need to do is to drag and drop the mineral onto the crusher!

##### James
Thanks for helping us! We can now finish this job in time! Therefore I will tell you how to work faster. Do you see the tracks around? Just build a mining cart and put it on the tracks. You can put the minerals but also the supplies from the rocks in it and transport them through the mines!

##### Hank
Thanks for the help. Please go back to James to finish your task. He will tell you about our secret   how to mine faster.

#### Guide
To complete the task kick one of the rocks in the mines to receive iron or coal, then trade it to James the same way you did for Bonnie with the potion.

Head north in the mines to find Hank to start the next task.

To complete this task trade the mineral to Hank the same way you did for James.

Finally talk to James again then leave the mines to complete the quest.

### Crafting

[[Image:Graalkingdoms startcrafting.png|250px|thumb|left|Enter the blacksmiths.]]
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startcraftingsmiths.png|250px|thumb|right|Complete the tasks for the blacksmiths.]]

#### Dialogue

##### Blacksmith Marion
Hello! I can tell you some information about crafting weapons and tools, you will need that for doing the shovel and later for playing successfully on Graal Kingdoms. For producing weapons or metallic tools there are basically two working steps: First you make basic things out of iron, like blades or iron plates. The second step is to actually make the weapon or tool, there you need the basic metallic items plus some more things like wood or gold.

Go to my brothers to hear more about the two steps.

##### Keld
I will explain you the first step, making basic metallic items. For that you fire the chimney with coal and put iron on it, both by simply grabbing it (). Then you need to equip the pliers, take the iron by pressing S near it, go to the water barrel and water it by pressing S again. The last thing you need to do is to go to the gray anvil and press S again to see a menu that shows what you can do with the hot iron. Those things are actually quite complicated right now, my brother will tell you how to easily make a shovel.

##### Morn
For actually making weapons or tools you need to go to the blue anvil, grab it (), then you see a menu of what items you can produce. When you click on an item you will see what you need to produce it in the lower part of the window. That can be blades, gold, wood or more seldom stuff like body parts from monsters or items that are in hidden chests in the underground dungeons. The shovel should only require some iron bars, select the shovel and click on the hammer-icon. After the crafting is finished take the shovel from the anvil. Also craft a lumber axe, you will need it later on! Then please come back to me.

#### Guide
To complete this quest talk to all the NPCs inside the blacksmiths and use the iron Morn give you to create a shovel and an axe on the anvil next to him.

### Plant Corns

[[Image:Graalkingdoms startplanting.png|250px|thumb|left|Dig up corn with the shovel and plant it.]]

#### Dialogue

##### Jeb
Hello! We need more people planting corn for us. If you want you can help us. Use your shovel to dig some seeds,  then when you have found a yellow corn seed dig a hole and put the seed inside to plant it. I will water it using my watering can and crop it with the scythe.

##### Jeb
Thanks for helping us! You are welcome to plant more corn plants. With the corn you can go to the wind mill which is turning the corn into flour which is needed for bread baking. Bakeries can be found in most towns, bread is good for increasing your food level.

#### Guide
To complete this quest dig a hole in the ground and pick up some corn, then drop the corn into the hole using the trading icon on the hole.

### Build a Ship

[[Image:Graalkingdoms startshipbuilding.png|250px|thumb|left|Talk to John Sr to start the quest.]]
[[Image:Graalkingdoms startshipbuildinglumber.png|250px|thumb|right|Cut the logs at the woodmill.]]

#### Dialogue

##### John Sr.
Ships are very important to travel from island to island. You can use the ferry but it is more fun to have an own ship command! You can find shipyards on every island. All you need is a few boards. If you have some just grab the logs to start building your ship. To finish my ship I need some boards. Please bring me 5 boards. Just drop a tree seed on the ground and double-click it. With some time until the tree is grown out and shop it with a lumber axe. Then take the log to the sawmill north of Wellington to cut it into boards. Drag the boards on me and press SHIFT to add more or CTRL to give me less then you release the left mouse button to drop the boards.

##### John Sr.
Great, thanks for the boards! Talk to my son now, he will explain to you how to bring it into the water.

#### Guide
Plant a tree by digging up a tree seed then doubling-click on the seed and wait for it to grow, Cut the tree down with your axe then take the log to the lumber mill in Wellington and turn it into wooden boards by pressing the A key under the red belt at the left of the lumber mill. Lastly take the 5 boards back to John and trade them to him using the trading icon. To complete the quest talk to John's son.

### Build a House

[[Image:Graalkingdoms starthousebuilding.png|250px|thumb|left|Talk to Jenny at Bomboria.]]

#### Dialogue

##### Jenny
Hello, look at my house, isn't it in a terrible shape? I told my husband to build a new one. Just talk to Justus, I'm sure he will tell you how you can build your own house. An own house is very nice because you are able to keep your things in it so you don't have to carry everything around for example.

##### Justus
You now know all I do, so you are well prepared to build your own house an a kingdom island.

##### Jenny
I hope you will build your own house now. Good luck on your journey and have fun!

#### Guide
To complete this quest talk to Jenny, then to Justus and then to Jenny again.

### Come Back

#### Dialogue

##### Joseph
Congratulations!
You have completed the starting quest. Here is a small reward for showing that you have mastered the tasks given.

### Towns
#### Kurol
During more barbaric times, Kurol served as a sort of trophy garden for Drakeero's Empress, Shelly. Following ZoJo's second takeover, it was re-appropriated as a sort of gathering locale, with several large, unlocked houses and spacious yards for meetings. Recently, under ZoJo, Zargon, and now Zoldan's quest to improve Zormite's living districts, it has been yet again changed into a sort of "upper class" city, were Zorbi merchants and nobles enjoy the peaceful ambiance of one of the archipelago's most far off towns.

#### Kalen

#### Cyrest

#### Vateril
The high-point in Zormite living standards during one of ZoJo's reigns inspired the Admiral and short-term Emperor Uri Vastinov to erect a new city. Vateril, despite its minor population, served as home to one of the few Zormite tailors. However, it was deemed unfit for hospitality and was barricaded by a Zorbi noble for several years, and was recently burned down by Zoldan in an attempt to purify the island of past blunders from ZoJo and Zargon's terms, further referencing the fact they could do no wrong.

## Worlds/Graal Kingdoms/Zormite/Old

[[Category:Zormite]][[Category:Roleplaying]]
The Zormites are a unique fish race which is deeply embedded within Graal's history. They are a nation of xenophobic bipedal species whom wish to gain better understanding of the world while at the same time flouting their superiority over the "land walkers".

= The Zormite Empire =
### Biology

The Zormite Empire is composed of fairly diverse species of the ocean. They are linked by one common trait - the ability to live underwater for long durations of time. 

#### Zormite

The Zormites are bipedal life forms on the Graalian planet who, for the most part, dwell underwater or in very humid conditions. They have two arms which has a claw on each arm. Unlike the land walkers of the surface the Zormites only hold four fingers as opposed to five (they have three forefingers and a thumb). Zormites range in height from 5' to 7' with an average weight of 280lbs for males and 230lbs for females. The diet of a Zormite is a unique menu of items ranging from seed weed to fish and even some land creatures found on the surface. The species has a shorter life span then other creatures, an average Zormite will only last roughly forty years.

The Zormites have a reproduction cycle not seen in the surface dwellers. The females of the Zormites will lay six to eight eggs each in a single hatchery in which the Zormite males will fertilize the eggs. Through this system there is no such thing as royal blood lines - all Zormite hatchlings are created the same without bearing on genetics and the other Zormites adopt these hatchlings as their own. There are few cases of hatchlings not being adopted (any hatchling not adopted enters the military service at birth where he/she will train at a young age). Hatcheries are usually divided amongst the various tribes of Zormite. The Zaeri Tribe Hatchery is a distant area from the Zorbi hatchery.

A Zormite's skin color can vary from Zormite to Zormite. Some are black, some are red, some are pink. The most common Zormite skin tone is an aqua blue. Zormite's vocal organs restrict them from making the S sound in Common... instead it sounds more like a Z sound.

#### Sahuagin

The Sahuagin are very similar to their Zormite brothers. However they possess attributes only found in the Sahuagin tribe. The Sahuagins are always green, there has never been an exception for this rule. They also hold the strength of three Zormites in one.

The average weight of a Sahuagin is 320lbs for males and 210lbs for females. Their average lifespan is roughly thirty years with their religious disdain for medical technology

#### Daulites

The Daulites are a fairly new race to surface to existence. They are a bipedal species of fish with a grayish tone to their skin. They are believed to have emerged from the sea when the meteorite clouded the ocean floor.

The Daulites differ from the Zormites in the fact that they are able to live on the surface for an indefinite time. When they swim for long durations of time then they must reach the top of the water to take air in from a hole in their head.

A Daulite is normally 5' tall, there has never been one recorded taller then 5'5". With their small stature they also have little weight. The average male scales about 110lbs and a female normally weighs about 90lbs.

The Daulites are very different from the Zormites and Sahuagin, however they were similar enough to be inducted into the Empire.

#### Orcarne

The Orcarne are large creatures hailing from the frigid waters of the north beyond the Antora Mountain. There are few in existence. 

Orcarnes live for a long period of time. Their life span is roughly one hundred and fifty years. The average weight of an Orcarne male is 520lbs and 560lbs for a female. An Orcarne diet consists of all vegetarian supplements such as seed weed and various roots.

Orcarnes also hold a special trait that allows them to never forget anything that occurs in their lifetime. This forges them into the wise grandfather persona, the all knowing beings who know from their experiences and not from the books of the world.

= History =

The History of the Empire is bleak at best. In the beginning there were only the various tribes, warring over the best hunting areas and the best waterfalls. For the most part these tribes were nomadic. They travelled from island to island in search of anything they could find. War was commonplace until the Empire was established.

This is the history of the Zormite Empire which was forged nearly seven hundred and fifty years ago.

### Emperors

#### Saint Zoron the Blessed
Saint Zoron is considered to be the first Zormite Emperor. He united the various Zormite and Sahuagin tribes. The wars ended and they became one entity... an Empire. Saint Zoron threw his spear into the waters of the Antora River and it struck a small island. He claimed the land for the Zormites and told the tribes to dig underneath the island - they were to build a grand castle there. So the lands grew under the influence of the Zormites. 

Then Zoron wrote the laws of the land in the sand that his spear has struck. They were proclaimed and the Empire adapted to them. The government was formed.

Zoron set forth and made many alliances with the meager land walker nations and established trade routes with them. Life was good in the Empire. Emperor Zoron the Blessed died a peaceful death.

#### Emperor Zoximus the Steadfast

With the death of the Saint Zoron the Sahuagin became restless once again. They raided within the Empire's borders. Emperor Zoximus was coronated with this overt revolt from the Sahuagin. He dismissed the raids however, instead he diverted the people's attentions by fighting the Surface Wars with the various human nations. He emerged victorious and the Sahuagin declared peace with the show of force with the humans. Using this to his advantage he set forth to better the relations of all tribes by taking out the Kraken scourges. Emperor Zoximus led an expedition to kill the Krakens of the south and of the east. He also took the Kraken of the north as a pet. That Kraken still lives today and is tied to the Emperor(s) to do their biddings.

Emperor Zoximus the Steadfast died from a Sahuagin assassin group who disliked the Zormite-Sahuagin peace.

#### Emperor Zerryne the Iron Fist

History now shows us that it was Emperor Zerryne the Iron Fist which orchestrated the Sahuagin Uprising that killed the late Emperor Zoximus. To create a common enemy for the Zormite people he declared war on the Sahuagin by setting loose the Kraken of the North which annihilated upwards to three-forths of the Sahuagin. Emperor Zerryne refined the laws of the land, created a harsh forced labor system, and forged the doctrine of the Empire - all of which are still in use today. Emperor Zerryne the Iron Fist broke many trade agreements and nearly started another surface war with the land walkers. Through all of this he is considered to be the creator of the modern Empire.

Emperor Zerryne the Iron Fist died by the hands of an enraged Zormite slave whom was sentanced to the underwater mines in forced labor.

#### Emperor Zanre the Enlightened

Emperor Zanre was crowned on a day that the [[Bomy Moon]] began to heat the surface. The waters were warm and the castle was busting with energy. Emperor Zanre was a diplomatic leader. He quickly resolved the differences with the Sahuagins. He disbanded a large portion of the Zormite Military and reestablished ties to the surface world. He also made the Empire more secular, pulling away from its attitude of doing things for the gods and more for doing things for the Empire.

The [[Tylarrian Orb]] was given to him as a peace offering from the Santerrian Kingdom. The Tylarrian Orb now resides with the council of Elders.

Emperor Zanre the Enlightened died of old age.

#### Emperor Zunthor the Great

Emperor Zunthor the Great's first action was to declare war on [[Dustari]]. This resulted in the Seventeen Years War which ultimately was a Zormite victory. The landwalker settlements near the Zormite border were removed and pushed back and the Sahuagin border became more civilized. He assimiliated most of the Sahuagin population into the Empire. Today the Sahuagin are not a seperate government but instead pledge themselves to the Emperor.

Emperor Zunthor the Great died of old age.

#### Emperor Zornine the Young

Times grew tough for the Zormite Empire. Resources were running low, food was coming in short supply, and the land walker nations began to advance and grow. Ergo first action Emperor Zornine the Young did was register all Sahuagin and put the majority of them in underwater mines and other locations of forced labor. There was no cause for this other then to better the Empire for the Zormites and not their Sahuagin brothers. The army grew large in numbers as the Sahuagin began to rebel across the nation. Every revolt was quelled by the Zormite military until the coming of Rygonark the Fearless in the playing field. Rygonark united many Sahuagin slaves to his army and he killed the various task masters of guard unit assigned to his mine. From there he set forth to attack mine after mine to raise his army. Emperor Zornine left the Zormite castle to his newly formed Council of Elders and set forth to defeat the Sahuagin General. The Empire saw victory against the Sahuagin slaves, however the Emperor met an untimely death.

#### Emperor Hiryuu the Quick

In the absence of an Emperor and in the middle of a civil war [[Dustari]] decided to declare war on the Zormite Empire as to take advantage of her current situation. The Council of Elders quickly decided to act and install another Emperor to combat the war. They selected a Zormite by the name of Hiryuu to take the leadership role of the empire. However Hiryuu did something not expected by the Empire - he made peace with [[Dustari]] and amended relations with them without blood shed. During this time [[Samurai]] and Zormite relations skyrocketted and the relations were at an all time high.

Emperor Hiryuu the Quick fled Zormite with a note stating that his intentions were to become a nomad like his forefathers. He was never seen again.

#### Emperor Zardogan the Wise

Months had passed after Emperor Hiryuu had left the kingdom's throne and the people were in desperate need of a new Emperor. The Sahuagins were beginning to form mass armies and began to throw their weight around with fortified Zormite positions, if nothing was to be done, war would once again terrorize the empire. Then finally the Zormite known as Zardogan appeared and took the throne. Selected unamiously by the Senate he took to the situations at hand. To the dismay of many and happiness of the masses, he declared the Sahuagins free from Zormite rule and gave them their rights back and let them free, or become part of the kingdom. Many believed his opinion was swayed by that of a close a guard, a Sahuagin Grappler known as Zappa. Shortly after the freedom granted to the Sahuagin Zardogan placed Zappa, General of the Zormite Army. Border skirmishes once again began to break out between the kingdoms of [[Dustari]]. Emperor Zardogan, continued tradition with having great ties with the [[Samurai]] and brought the Zormites into the battle with his Zormites. The borders that had been lost to [[Dustari]] were soon regained and the battles ended. Several months later after rumors of [[Dustari]] Assassins sneaking past Zormite borders, the Senate began to worry about the well-being of Zardogan and the fact the Dustari may be out for him. Emperor Zardogan told the senate to fear not, and that what he was here for had been accomplished. Three days later Zardogan was found dead in his bed. Although Zardogans fate had been sealed he had in fact faked his death and journeyed down to Santerrain to live a more peaceful life, as a farmer. He died of old age.

#### Emperor Zarnage the Pillager

After the "death"? of Zardogan… Zarnage gained control of the throne; he was the first bomy emperor. Exploiting his citizen’s good will and racial tensions he began several raids on the human nations. This raised the morale of his soldiers, but it made the international community dislike him. He died of old age without announcing his heir to the throne.

#### Emperor Zoad the Defeated

After Zarnage died, the High Council held a meeting to discuss whom should be the next emperor. They then appointed Zoad the next Emperor of the empire. During this time the land-walker kingdom known as [[Dustari]] was quickly gaining power and sought the rich resources of the Zormite Empire. [[Dustari]] conquered the Zormite Empire during this time and Zoad fled. The Dustarians held a firm grip on the Zormite Empire, but remarkably the Empire was allowed to retain their culture and government as long as their loyalty was with the [[Dustari]] crown.

#### Emperor Zyko the Revolutionary

Zyko came to power and one of the most immediate things he performed was to revolt against [[Dustari]], this revolution of the Zormites failed and much blood was spilt. In the end the Zormite Empire lost another war against [[Dustari]]. Emperor Zyko was allowed to keep his position as the regent of the Zormite Empire as long as there was a Dustarian advisor. Zyko’s subjects became unruly stating that “No Emperor of the Empire should bend to the will of a land walker�?. To get his citizens off the subject he began campaigns against a Zormite tribe to the North East named the Zaeri. The Zaeri Tribe was a nomadic Zormite tribe. The Zaeri began to engage the Zormites after seven settlements were ravaged by the Zormite Empire.

Emperor Zyko died of old age with Zormites protesting his weakness againgst Dustari.

#### Emperor Zeetos the Explorer and Emperor Zauis the Overthrown

When Emperor Zeetos and Emperor Zauis came to power it was an unpresidented era of Zormite government: There were two Emperors in power at one time. The Zormite people adored the Emperors as they were two well respected Zormites from the tribe of Zorbi, one of the nobler of the tribe of the empire… but the empire was neglected by the duo crown. The castle began to break apart and the thrones became cold. The Zormite people were left to survive by themselves as the two emperors took extended voyages across the vast seas for exploration. The Emperors did return one day with wonderful news, they found a new land to the south and claimed an island for their own.

Emperor Zeetos and Emperor Zauis were both killed when a sea serpent took them by surprise and sucked them both into a makeshift wirlpool. The Zormite Empire entered a Dark Age. There was no stablility in the leadership of government. Even the council of Elders changed every week.

#### Emperor Zurkiba the Warmonger

Emperor Zurkiba was a member of the Zaeri Tribe. An oppressed tribe to the north east. However he was unique from other Zaeris, whom were believed to be uncultured and having a severe lack of technology, he had an advanced scientific and warfare mind. He understood that the Zormite Empire was in an era of instability so he took advantage of that. At this time the [[Dustari]] troops stationed in the Zormite Empire were pulled back to their own nation due to the events of [[Ackbar]], this meant that there would be no opposition to his invasion. 

On an night where there was no sun showing the Zaeri attacked the Zormite Castle. There was little opposition and the Zaeri quickly took the castle. Zurkiba then invited the various tribal leaders to his castle in which he united them in an unknown way. The Zormite Empire quickly found an awareness of their former being and united once more. Zurkiba's first action was to invade and annex the Bomy Nation to the south. There was no external kingdom to oppose this move. The Empire then quickly took Mount Antora and the settlements around the [[Bomy Moon]]. 

Zurkiba wanted massive war movements, but the mines around him were ancient and dry. Rummaging through maps he found the claims of the Zormite Empire on an archipelago to the south. He sent colonist to settle the lands of the island. The colonist established the settlement of [[Kalen]] and it became very wealthy.

Finding new wealth in resources and money the Zormite Empire declared war on the Kingdom of Santerrain. A quick victory was won over the [[Samurai]] nation with the recent formation of the Imperial Guards, an elite faction of the Zormite military. Now the Zormites controlled three forths of the known world, they became the super power of the world and no nation stood in their way.

Emperor Zurkiba died in a [[Karakaze Troupe]] ambush when he was visiting the destroyed [[Samurai]] castle to discuss vassalship with the Zormite-appointed leader of Samurai.

#### Emperor Zatts the Just and Emperor Zappa the Brave

Emperor Zatts and Emperor Zappa ascended to the throne with the last wishes of the former Emperor Zurkiba. During this time the world was in panic as the astrologist of Samurai stated that the end of the world would come in the form of a fiery red ball that would crash on the former lands of Dustari. They said that it would destroy all life unless they weren’t there when the ball crashed. The nation of Samurai began their packing to depart for a newly discovered new world, the same for the remnants of the former Dustari Kingdom, and the pirates. The Zormites stood their ground. Some fled to the new world to create a new life while the others stayed home and erected defenses. Emperor Zatts and Emperor Zappa were the organizers of their defensive efforts. They stood from atop of Mt. Antora and watched a massive earthquake destroy their castle... their home, the fireball doing more damage then were expected. They took some of the Zormite survivors into a cavern to see out the rest of the Armageddon.

The two Emperors emerged from their cavern to see a black sky and a black ocean. They returned to the castle to find it in ruins. The Zormite Empire seemed doomed. No Zormite held the knowledge of masonry, much less advanced building techniques. There was no way they could rebuild the majestic castle that was once called the center of the Empire. They cleared some of the rubble and continued to lead the government. They understood that the other nations and races were still behind the Zormites. They rebuilt quickly and went to establish their supremacy over the lands again.

Emperor Zatts was never found, he is presumed dead. Emperor Zappa was killed encircled by an Orcish legion who had intentions on killing the Zormite leadership. Emperor Zappa was impaled by eight arrows through vital organs and muscles but continued his fight. He was able to kill the vast majority of the Orcs but he succumbed to the sheer numbers of the Orcs.

## Worlds/Graal Skills

[[Category:Worlds]][[Category:Graal Skills]]
[[Worlds/Graal Skills|Graal Skills]] is a game server in which players can play Card/Arcade style to compete against other players or break high scores.

=Games=

### Card Games
Play some of the most favoured card games, each with
an easy-to-use interface and skilled computer players!

#### Poker
Play Poker Texas Hold'em! Each player receives two cards which
are only visible to him/her. Together with the 5 cards in the middle
of the table you need to form a hand that is stronger than
the hand of the other players. But those cards are only revealed after
some rounds of betting. Choose wisely if you call (bet the same amount
the previous player was betting), raise your bet, or fold your hand to
not risk loosing your money to an even better opponent.

#### Belote
Players in france call it Belote, Contrée, Coinche
or La vache depending on where they live,
but the spirit of the game is always the same:
a challenging card game that is played with teams, where
beside the cards in your hand your way of playing is also
very important.
When you create a new party then you can also modify the rules
to match your favoured way of playing the game.
If you cannot find three friends for playing, then the
computer will replace the missing players and play with a good level of AI.


#### Tarot
Play Tarot! You can either play vs computer or with 2, 3 or 4 friends.
Basic rules: The game is played with 21 trumps, one joker, and 4 colors each of 14 cards (1..10, jack (V), cavalier (C), queen (D) and king (R)). 
You need to play the same color, if you can't then use a trump. Joker always works.
For more information: [http://www.pagat.com/tarot/frtarot.html Tarot Rules]

### Pool Billiard
Play this popular bar game where you push the balls into the table pockets!
You can either play 8-Ball (balls are split into solid and stripes), 9-Ball 
(pott the 9-Ball by playing the lowest ball on the table), Straight (first who 
potts 8 balls wins) or Snooker (pott a red, then a color).

#### 8-Ball
Play this popular bar game where you push the balls into the table pockets!
The first pocketed ball decides which type of balls you need to play - 
either the solid colored balls or striped balls. The opponent is then
playing the other type. You can see the color of ball you need to play
near your name. You need to play the 7 balls of your color and then
pot the black ball into any pocket, but don't play the black ball before
that because it will immediatelly end the game.

#### 9-Ball
The goal of this pool variant is to pot the yellow striped 
ball - the 9-Ball. You are not allowed to play that ball
directly, you need to either pot the lowest valued ball or
use that ball to pot the 9-Ball indirectly. 9-Ball is very
popular as a professional pool game.

#### Straight
In Straight pool the player with most pocketed balls is winning.
Since there are exactly 15 balls you require 8 balls to win. The
balls don't need to be played in a particular order.

#### Snooker
Snooker is a pool variant with 15 red balls, 6 colored balls and one
white ball. The players must score one red ball (worth 1 point) and
then a colored ball (worth 2-7 points), which is then placed back on
the table. When all red balls are potted then the end-game is played where
the colored balls must be potted starting with the lowest valued ball, the
yellow ball, and finishing with the black ball.
If you do a foul then the opponent gains a minimum of 4 points and up to
7 points depending on if you have played a higher valued ball wrongfully.
The balls will be placed back on the table and you will need to repeat the
play. By trapping the opponent into a situation where he cannot easily
hit the desired balls you can gain a lot of points. Such a situation is
called "snooker".

### Board Games
Play against the high skilled computer players in
Chess or Checkers, or invite a friend to play a round
of Mahjongg or Reversi!
If you like to train your brain then try to
solve the Sudoku puzzles!

#### Chess
Play Chess online against other players or
against the computer!
The game is played on a checkered 8x8 board,
one side controls the white and the other side the black pieces.
The goal of the game is to checkmate the opponent's king by bringing him
into a situation where he is under attack (in check) and cannot escape.

#### Checkers
game is also known as Draughts.
It's played on a checkered 8x8 board or on a 10x10 board,
one side controls the white and the other side the black pieces.
Normal pieces can only move one step diagonally forward, but can
also capture backwards. Once you reach the farthest row forward
(kings row) then the piece becomes a king and can move any
distance and also diagonally backwards.
In tournaments the 10x10 board is preferred. Also the computer
only plays on the 10x10 board.

#### Mahjongg
Play Mahjongg solitaire!
The goal of the game is to remove all 144 tiles by finding
pairs of identical tiles. Only tiles that don't have a neighbour
on either the left or right side can be removed.
Also keep an eye on the clock or you will run out of time
before solving the puzzle. If you are lost and can't find
any matching tiles then you can also use a hint.

#### Reversi
Play Reversi with another player or against the computer! 
The game is also known as Othello.
One side plays with white coins and the other side with black coins.
The goal is to cover the majority of the board with your
own coins. Each round you can place one coin: this turns any
opponents coin that is in a straight or diagonal line between 
the new coin and your other coins into your own color. If you
cannot turn any opponents coin into your own color then you
must pass.
When most fields are covered by coins then a single coin can
often flip dozens of opponents coins and completely change the
outcome of the game. Keep care to not lose the important
corner fields to your opponent!

#### Sudoku
Place numbers intelligently to have each row,
column and block never contain the same number
twice.
The game makes it possible to mark lines or fields
with the same number to make it easier to detect problems.
You can choose between easy, medium and hard puzzles.

### Arcade Games
Play the arcaded games if you like action!
In BomberMad you can play against 4 friends - place
bombs and keep care to not run into an explosion! Collect
items to power up your bombs and try to trap your enemy.
In Marble Flip you swap marbles to line up 3 marbles
of the same color. Use combos to send time bombs to your enemy!
Marble Maze, Asteroids and Invaders X are based on
classic game ideas and let you hunt for high scores.

#### BomberMad
Bomb up your enemy! Try to beat the strong computer player 
or play against up to 4 other players. You can collect various items 
for increasing the power of your bombs, the number of bombs you 
can lay at the same time, a glove to throw bombs or a remote control 
to let the bombs explode from a safe distance.

#### Marble Flip
Swap the marbles to make lines of 3 marbles of the
same color! Click on two neighboured marbles to
exchange them. This game requires some luck,
but also good eyes.
Keep an eye on the time bar, each successful combination
of marbles adds more time. With combos (removal of
more than 3 marbles at once) you get stars which let
you buy hints or time. In the multiplayer mode
you can even "bomb" your friends using stars, that
will reduce their precious time.

#### Marble Maze
In MarbleMaze you are controlling a ball through
a 3D isometric labyrinth and must collect all the gems.
Controlling a rolling ball is not as easy as it might
sound, especially on slopes or when jumping over cliffs.

#### Asteroids
Asteroids is a space shooter where you can turn your
space ship by 360 degrees and must avoid collisions with
asteroids which always fly around you. Once you shoot
at the asteroids they will split and become even more
dangerous, until they completely vanish. Don't forget to
collect the bonus items which refill your shield or give
you super bombs.

#### Invaders X
Invaders X is a vertical shooter where you need to
fight against a constant flow of enemy space ships
approaching from the top of the screen.

Use ''Ctrl'' to fire or press ''Space''
to use your laser. Collect bonus items to get a
more powerful shot, to refill your laser energy or
to speed up your space ship.

## Worlds/Graal X

{{playerworld}}

This server was the 15th server to ever be hosted on graal via Payed-Player-Hosted server. :-D.

{{stub}}

### The Modern Rivalry

Graal X was a very successful server during the 'older' days of Graal, holding quite an impressive playercount at the owner (KuJi)'s disposal.

Although later on the modern boom began, the early version of Atrius began, with MadJ clenching ideas, and power. KuJi began to consider Atrius a 'threat'.

KuJi went on to introduce Era-ish systems, which the players loved, such as more business's, Era-styled events, a fishing system, and worked on other jobs.
Players adored KuJi until MadJ pushed back a little bit with another update, cars.

Throughout the month's, KuJi and MadJ had a back and forth player war, trying to keep their players with newer and newer systems that other servers did not have, and KuJi was clearly the winner in the battle.

KuJi later kept his ground with newly created Spawn, Reborn, and even bypassed Era a few times.

Until Trinity came.

Trinity bashed KuJi, and Graal X to the ground, and the new war between KuJi and new owner, James began.

Graal X later became a MIA project.

Years passed, with different Atrius versions comming out, and Graal X came back during the Jenn deficit of Era, which caused modern players to find another place to call their 'home'. Players equally spread out to new Atrian City, and Graal X to give the servers a try. There was really no competition throughout this time, as both owners figured they kept a good enough playercount at 20-30 players daily, they just kept their rivalry formal, and even got together a few times to help out one another.

Then 'tragedy' struck during Atrius Version 4, an attack was plotted on Atrius during one of the best times, and a hack script was unleashed on Atrius from one of the scripters, although James did not declare a full out war, many of the understaffmen, led by the Co-Owner, and the Manager, called an all out search to find out what happened, all evidence pointed to Graal X, and KuJi's new 'right hand man' after MadJ quit, G-Man.

After being yelled at to not do it by James and Mag, the Manager of Atrius 'infiltrated' Graal X, and pulled a hack script on there to even the score.
KuJi and G-Man were shocked, and placed the IP on full alert, KuJi and James were again at war, and the manager was punished, but never globally banned.

KuJi and G-Man later scrapped the project, and began to take a new side to Graal X.
Since G-Man worked on Icarus, a server that was brought up by MadJ and Drogan, he helped Icarus more then Graal X. Icarus was later scrapped due to the owners, and staff having real-life issues to attend to.

KuJi, knowing that time was running out for GX to properly hold a fight against Atrius, rumors came about that KuJi personally begged G-Man and Sage_Shadowbane to give him Icarus content, something that guaranteed him the ability to defeat Atrius in any battle, after the Icarus staff gave in to content that should not have even been theirs, KuJi worked on custom bodies.

Most content that you see today on Graal X was provided to Graal X by Icarus, by two staff members that really had no specific permission from Drogan or MadJ to give such content away anyway.

### Joey's stupidity

In May, 2007, Joey (Or KuJi to some) supposibly either issued himself, or asked someone to directly attack the server Atrius.
Atrius lost everything, and TheJames had to call Stefan to get the backups back.
Although at the moment nobody knows exactly HOW KuJi got onto Atrius, rumors are that he hacked in, other rumors are that he USDed a staff member to get him in, and another rumor was that Mike (Princeofkenshin) hired him.
When Stefan had to bring the backups back, he wasn't happy, and obviously all evidence pointed to KuJi;
Graal X was shutdown just hours after that, and KuJi was globally banned.

## Worlds/Horrification/Puzzles

[[Category:Horrification]]
### Notice
[[Worlds/Horrification|Horrification]] is currently Under Construction, and some minor details are subject to change at any time. You can likely get a taste of playing a puzzle by asking [[User:Horrified|Horrified]] nicely.

### About
"Puzzles" are [[Worlds/Horrification|Horrification]]'s single-player mini-games played for enjoyment and competitive highscores, created by [[User:Horrified|Horrified]]. They are made from random creativity for enjoyment, and are 2-D.

### How to Play
[[Image:Graal hor-puzzle.png|thumb|Puzzle Select Menu]]
You open the puzzle select menu by pressing F4 or the "Puzzle Select" button on the Graal taskbar.
                                       
Puzzles have fairly simple commands to be played on [[Worlds/Horrification|Horrification]]. They are all "timed", meaning you have to make it to the end as soon as possible. You view your time by holding down "T", and you can leave a puzzle by either completing it or saying "/exit". You can not chat or leave the puzzle without completing or exiting it.

### Difficulties
Horrification has 3 difficulties: Easy, Medium and Hard. Puzzles are rated based on player's choice; At the end of a "Not Rated" Puzzle (usually new puzzles), you select what difficulty you thought it was and press OK. The scores are viewed by Horrification Staff, and they pick the difficulties at the end of the week based on vote.

Difficulties help players stray far from any puzzles that might be too challenging or too easy for them; it also gives them an idea of what they might be in for.

### Control

All puzzles use different ways of player control, such as one puzzle, "Sk8rboi", having a skating-like movement while you make your way past all walls, while "Gravity Madness", uses a somewhat common Gravity system that allows you to jump with A, and cannot move up or down, only left/right. 

The commands are explained in a quick "Help" message on your screen. These can be disabled after the second time of playing the puzzle.
